import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Simulation
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Composition
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Wrappers
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Encoding
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassP.TimeConstructible
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Loop
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Primitives
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Catalog

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# MIG-1 statement gate: named witnesses, their spec theorems, the rows as corollaries

**Status: the statement-gate unit of backlog row MIG-1; not a library file.** It elaborates
against the campaign snapshot, in which today's rows are public and today's witnesses private.
The unit has eight parts, one per home file, each opened by a section comment beginning `════`
and by `-- @landing` and `-- @imports` lines. Landing is a set of edits to the existing home
modules, not a new module:

* **Witness definitions.** A witness that is today a private definition of its home file
  (`idTM`, `constTM`, `ifEqTM`, `condTM`, `timedCondTM`, `Turing.pairDiagTM`, `lengthBitsTM`,
  `prependTM`, `incFixedTM`, `pairValidTM`, `pairExtractTM`, `unaryTokenTM`, `appendBitTM`,
  `loopHostTM`, `callTM`) lands by an asserted scripted rename **in place**: the `private`
  keyword goes, the name changes by the rename map of the pack, the body is unchanged, and the
  docstring becomes the one given here. Every other witness (`toCodeTM`, `polyUnaryTM`,
  `polyBitsTM`, `pairLenCheckTM`, `stripLastTM`, `pairMapSndTM`, `splitSolveTM`,
  `splitSolveWithTM`, `emitLoopTM`, `callEntry`, `callExit`) is a new definition whose body is
  today's witness term, from the row proof named in its docstring. `pairMapSndTM` alone lands
  at the fill stage, with the forwarding-controller family that moves from Catalog. The bodies
  here are the source bodies verbatim modulo the rename map
  (`audits/logs/mig1-statements-identity.log`).
* **Gate shims** (blocks between `-- @shim begin` and `-- @shim end`) are verbatim copies of
  private definitions that a witness body uses. They exist only because a private declaration
  cannot be named from another module; on landing they are dropped, since the originals are
  already in the home file (or, for the forwarding controller, move there with their family).
  They are checked verbatim by the same script.
* **Spec theorems and supporting lemmas** are new public statements, inserted in the home file
  before the first row they serve. A spec whose proof needs a private lemma of its home file is
  `sorry` here, under a proof sketch that names the existing proof it comes from; a spec whose
  proof needs only public declarations is proved here, and lands with that proof.
* **Row corollaries** `MIG1Gate.row_X` are stated as `type_of% @X`, the landed row's own type,
  so this unit elaborates only if every row keeps its statement while becoming a corollary of
  the specs. They are not landed in the statement PR: at the fill stage each row's proof becomes
  the proof given here, and the row's statement, name and home stay as they are. The other
  `MIG1Gate` declarations are evidence too: the two head lemmas that move from Catalog to
  Simulation, and the two retired canonical rows re-derived as their consumers will be.

The spec theorems use the library's existing style (`ComputesInTime`, `ComputesFunInTime`,
`spaceUsed` from `initCfg`, `Cfg.ofWords` seams), not `Turing.Contract` instances (user decision
of 2026-10-13; `audits/evidence/mig1/MIG1-design.md` §2). The decision rests on the shape of the
facts (whole-machine runs from `initCfg`, judged by the output, with no exact endpoint) and on the
order of work (a contract needs a named machine, so named witnesses come first, for MIG-11 and
MIG-17); the layering obstacle of design §2, reason 1, lasts only until MIG-0b splits
`Build/Contract.lean` into a core that does not import Catalog.

## Main definitions

* Composition: `idTM`, `constTM`, `ifEqTM`, `condTM`. Wrappers: `timedCondTM`.
  Encoding: `Turing.pairDiagTM`, `toCodeTM`. TimeConstructible: `lengthBitsTM`.
* Loop: `loopHostTM`, `emitLoopTM`, `callTM`, `callEntry`, `callExit`.
* Primitives: `prependTM`, `incFixedTM`, `pairValidTM`, `pairExtractTM`, `polyUnaryTM`,
  `polyBitsTM`, `pairLenCheckTM`, `stripLastTM`, `pairMapSndTM`, `splitSolveTM`,
  `splitSolveWithTM`, `unaryTokenTM`, `appendBitTM`.

## Main results

* The generic run lemmas `Turing.MultiTapeTM.abs_workTapePos_runFrom_sub_le` and
  `Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime.spaceUsed_le` (proved), and the canonical-word endpoint lemmas
  `Turing.Cfg.ofWords_copy_endpoint`, `Turing.Cfg.ofWords_transfer_endpoint` (proved).
* One time spec per witness, a space spec for the witnesses with their own space argument,
  and the configuration-level contracts of the loop host and the clean call.
* The 53 rows, `Complexity.timeConstructible_id` and `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_spaceUsedByTape`
  as `MIG1Gate.row_*` corollaries.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§1.2: the machine model and its basic routines; §1.3:
  time constructibility; Definition 4.1: the visited-cells space measure.)
-/

/-! ════ Part 1. `TuringMachine/Simulation.lean`: the generic run lemmas, the branch union's
space, and the two head lemmas moved from Catalog. -/
-- @landing TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Simulation
-- @imports TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Simulation

namespace Turing.MultiTapeTM

/-- **Head displacement along a run** (landing:
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.abs_workTapePos_runFrom_sub_le`, new in `TuringMachine/Simulation.lean`,
namespace `Turing.MultiTapeTM`; statement and proof verbatim from the H2 statement-gate draft
`audits/evidence/h2/StepBlockDraft.lean.txt:729`, whose proof is `CodeSimulator`'s private
`h1Run_headBound`). After `t` steps of any machine, every work head is within `t` cells of where
it started: the run form of `Turing.MultiTapeTM.workTapePos_step_le`. [AB09, §1.2: a step moves
each head by at most one cell.] One lemma serves MIG-1, where it replaces Catalog's private
`f2_head_steps` (the same fact as two inequalities, retired with MIG-1 by backlog F6-1(g)), and
H2, whose design note O9 moves it below `Build/StepBlock.lean` with MIG-1. Whichever of the two
PRs lands first introduces it; the other cites it.

**Proof sketch.** Telescope the displacement into its `t` one-step differences; the triangle
inequality and the one-step bound give `t`. -/
theorem abs_workTapePos_runFrom_sub_le {m : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (d : Cfg m Bool S x) (t : ℕ) (j : Fin m) :
    |(M.runFrom d t).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤ (t : ℤ) := by
  let height (u : ℕ) := (M.runFrom d u).workTapePos j
  have unit (u : ℕ) : |height (u + 1) - height u| ≤ 1 := by
    simpa only [height, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step'] using
      MultiTapeTM.workTapePos_step_le (tm := M) (M.runFrom d u) j
  calc
    |(M.runFrom d t).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| =
        |∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, (height (u + 1) - height u)| := by
      rw [Finset.sum_range_sub]; rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, |height (u + 1) - height u| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _u ∈ Finset.range t, (1 : ℤ) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun u _ => unit u)
    _ = (t : ℤ) := by simp

end Turing.MultiTapeTM

namespace Turing.FinTM

/-- **Space from time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime.spaceUsed_le`, new in
`TuringMachine/Simulation.lean`; statement and proof are Catalog's private `f2_space_of_time`,
moved). If `M` halts on `x` with output `y` within `T` steps, then at every time `t` its work
tapes have visited at most `M.k · (T + 1)` cells in all. [AB09, Definition 4.1, and the remark
opening the proof of Theorem 4.2: a machine running in time `T` visits at most `T + 1` cells of
each tape.]

**Proof sketch.** After the halt the configuration no longer changes, so every head position at
any time `t` already occurs at some time `u ≤ T`. Each tape's visited set is therefore contained
in the image of `{0, …, T}`, which has at most `T + 1` elements; sum over the `k` tapes. -/
theorem ComputesInTime.spaceUsed_le {M : FinTM Bool} {x y : List Bool} {T : ℕ}
    (h : M.ComputesInTime x y T) (t : ℕ) :
    M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ M.k * (T + 1) := by
  have hh := ((computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp h).1
  have hsub (i : Fin M.k) :
      M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg x) t i ⊆
        M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg x) T i := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨u, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
    by_cases hu : u ≤ T
    · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨u, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), rfl⟩
    · have hr : M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u =
          M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) T := by
        rw [show u = T + (u - T) by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add,
          MultiTapeTM.runFrom_of_halt _ hh]
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨T, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega),
        congrArg (fun c => c.workTapePos i) hr.symm⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin M.k, (T + 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      exact (Finset.card_le_card (hsub i)).trans (by
        unfold MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead
        exact (Finset.card_image_le).trans (by rw [Finset.card_range]))
    _ = _ := by simp

/-- **The branch union's space** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.branchTM_spaceUsed`, new in
`TuringMachine/Simulation.lean` after `branchTM_computes`; statement verbatim from Catalog's
private `f2_branch_space`, whose proof moves with it). The branch union selecting `b` uses
exactly the selected machine's space plus one origin cell for each tape of the idle bank.

**Proof sketch.** Catalog's `f2_branch_space`: the branch union runs the selected machine on its
own bank (`leftCfg_run`, `rightCfg_run`) and never moves the other bank's heads, whose visited
sets stay the origin singletons; split the sum over the two banks with `Fin.sum_univ_add`, which
replaces the copied `f2_sum_add`. -/
theorem branchTM_spaceUsed (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.spaceUsed ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) t =
      if b then M₁.tm.spaceUsed (M₁.tm.initCfg x) t + M₂.k
      else M₂.tm.spaceUsed (M₂.tm.initCfg x) t + M₁.k := by
  sorry

namespace MIG1Gate

/-- **Moved head lemma** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.rewind_scan_heads`, moved verbatim, name and
statement unchanged, from `Build/Catalog.lean:10376` to `TuringMachine/Simulation.lean` after
`Turing.FinTM.timed_rewind`; here inside `MIG1Gate` to avoid the clash with the Catalog
original). A native input rewind keeps every work head fixed, at every prefix, including its
dispatch step.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the input position; each step is a `controlAction`. -/
theorem rewind_scan_heads {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (scan : S) (dest : Option S)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with
      | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan)
      | none => controlAction .pos dest) :
    ∀ (j : ℕ) (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x), cfg.state = some scan →
      cfg.inputPos.val = j → j ≤ x.length →
      ∀ u ≤ j + 1, (tm.runFrom cfg u).workTapePos = cfg.workTapePos := by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro cfg hs hj hp u hu
    rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp hu with rfl | rfl
    · rfl
    · have hz : cfg.inputPos = 0 := Fin.ext hj
      have hi : cfg.inputSymbol = none := by simp [Cfg.inputSymbol, hz]
      change (tm.step cfg).workTapePos = _
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hs, htr, hi, controlAction_apply]
  | succ j ih =>
    intro cfg hs hj hp u hu
    cases u with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ u =>
      have hi : cfg.inputSymbol = some (x[j]'(by omega)) :=
        inputSymbolInner j (by omega) (by omega)
      have he : tm.step cfg =
          {cfg with state := some scan, inputPos := moveInputPos cfg.inputPos .neg} := by
        simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hs, htr, hi, controlAction_apply]
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, he]
      apply ih _ rfl _ (by omega) u (by omega)
      simp only [moveInputPos_neg_val]
      omega

/-- **Moved head lemma** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.rewind_heads`, moved verbatim from
`Build/Catalog.lean:10415`, name and statement unchanged; here inside `MIG1Gate`). The bounded
rewind reaches its destination with the input head at `1` within `pos + 2` steps, and every work
head stays put throughout. (Copied verbatim except that one line of 109 characters is wrapped.)

**Proof sketch.** One start step, then `Turing.FinTM.rewind_scan` for the run and
`Turing.FinTM.rewind_scan_heads` for the heads. -/
theorem rewind_heads {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S)
    (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan))
    (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with
      | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan)
      | none => controlAction .pos dest)
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : c.state = some start) :
    ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2,
      tm.runFrom c r = {c with state := dest, inputPos := 1} ∧
      ∀ u ≤ r, (tm.runFrom c u).workTapePos = c.workTapePos := by
  have hstep : tm.step c =
      {c with state := some scan, inputPos := moveInputPos c.inputPos .neg} := by
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hs, hstart, controlAction_apply]
  have hp : (moveInputPos c.inputPos .neg).val ≤ x.length := by
    rw [moveInputPos_neg_val]
    have := c.inputPos.isLt
    omega
  refine ⟨1 + ((moveInputPos c.inputPos .neg).val + 1), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [moveInputPos_neg_val]; omega
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add]
    change tm.runFrom (tm.step c) _ = _
    rw [hstep, rewind_scan tm scan dest hscan _ rfl hp]
  · intro u hu
    cases u with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ u =>
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, hstep]
      exact rewind_scan_heads tm scan dest hscan (moveInputPos c.inputPos .neg).val _ rfl rfl hp u
        (by omega)

end MIG1Gate

end Turing.FinTM

/-! ════ Part 2. `TuringMachine/Composition.lean`: the copy, constant, comparison and
conditional machines, the buffered composition's specs, and the seven rows. -/
-- @landing TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Composition
-- @imports TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Composition
-- @imports TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Simulation

namespace Turing.FinTM

/-- **The copy machine** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.idTM`, made public in place at
`TuringMachine/Composition.lean:88`, body unchanged). A machine with no work tapes and one state
that writes each input symbol to its output while moving right, and halts on the blank after
the input. [AB09, §1.2] -/
def idTM : FinTM Bool where
  k := 0
  State := Unit
  tm :=
    { q₀ := ()
      tr := fun _ inp _ =>
        match inp with
        | some b => ⟨SignType.pos, fun i => i.elim0, some b, some ()⟩
        | none => ⟨SignType.zero, fun i => i.elim0, none, none⟩ }

/-- **The copy machine's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.idTM_computes`, new in `Composition`
before `computesFunInTime_id`). On every input `x` the copy machine halts within `|x| + 1`
steps with output `x`. [AB09, §1.2]

**Proof sketch.** The body of today's `computesFunInTime_id` (`Composition.lean:137`) up to its
final weakening: by the private run invariant `idTM_run`, after `|x|` steps the machine is live,
its input head is at cell `|x| + 1` and it has written `x`; there it reads the blank, and the
next step halts without writing. -/
theorem idTM_computes (x : List Bool) : idTM.ComputesInTime x x (x.length + 1) := by
  sorry

/-- **The constant machine** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.constTM`, made public in place at
`Composition.lean:168`, body unchanged). A machine with no work tapes whose `|w| + 1` states
form the emission chain of the fixed word `w`: it writes `w`, one symbol per step, ignoring its
input, and halts. [AB09, §1.2] -/
def constTM (w : List Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := 0
  State := Fin (w.length + 1)
  tm := { q₀ := 0, tr := fun i _ _ => emitAction w id i }

/-- **The constant machine's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.constTM_computes`, new in
`Composition` before `computesFunInTime_const`; proved, the row's body moved). On every input
the constant machine halts within `|w| + 1` steps with output `w`. [AB09, §1.2]

**Proof sketch.** The emission chain writes `w` in `|w|` steps and halts on the next
(`Turing.FinTM.emit_halts`), appending to the initially empty output. -/
theorem constTM_computes (w x : List Bool) :
    (constTM w).ComputesInTime x w (w.length + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨hs, ho⟩ := emit_halts (constTM w).tm w id (fun _ _ _ => rfl)
    ((constTM w).tm.initCfg x) rfl
  exact ⟨_, hs, by simpa only [MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init, List.nil_append] using ho, rfl⟩

/-- **The fixed-word comparator** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.ifEqTM`, made public in place at
`Composition.lean:189`, body unchanged). A machine with no work tapes that compares its input
with the fixed word `w₀` symbol by symbol and then runs the emission chain of `u` (on an exact
match followed by the blank) or of `v` (on the first mismatch, an early blank, or a symbol past
the end of `w₀`). [AB09, §1.2] -/
def ifEqTM (w₀ u v : List Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := 0
  State := Fin (w₀.length + 1) ⊕ (Fin (u.length + 1) ⊕ Fin (v.length + 1))
  tm :=
    { q₀ := .inl 0
      tr := fun q inp _ => match q with
        | .inl i =>
          if h : i.val < w₀.length then
            if inp = some w₀[i.val] then
              controlAction .pos (some (.inl ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩))
            else controlAction 0 (some (.inr (.inr 0)))
          else if inp = none then controlAction 0 (some (.inr (.inl 0)))
            else controlAction 0 (some (.inr (.inr 0)))
        | .inr (.inl i) => emitAction u (fun j => .inr (.inl j)) i
        | .inr (.inr i) => emitAction v (fun j => .inr (.inr j)) i }

/-- **The comparator's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.ifEqTM_computes`, new in `Composition`
before `computesFunInTime_ifEq`). The comparator computes `w ↦ if w = w₀ then u else v` within
`(|w₀| + max |u| |v| + 3)·(n + 1)` steps, the constant of today's row made explicit.

**Proof sketch.** The body of today's `computesFunInTime_ifEq` (`Composition.lean:335`): the
private comparison run `ifEq_run` reaches the halt within `|w₀| + max |u| |v| + 3` steps with
the selected word as output, and that constant is at most its product with `n + 1`. -/
theorem ifEqTM_computes (w₀ u v : List Bool) :
    (ifEqTM w₀ u v).ComputesFunInTime (fun w => if w = w₀ then u else v)
      (fun n => (w₀.length + max u.length v.length + 3) * (n + 1)) := by
  sorry

/-- **The buffered composition computes the composite** (landing:
`Turing.FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesFunInTime`, new in `Composition` before
`computesFunInTime_comp`; proved, the row's body moved). If `M₁` computes `f` within `T₁` and
`M₂` computes `g` within a monotone `T₂`, then `bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂` computes `g ∘ f` within
`2·(T₁ n + T₂ (T₁ n) + 1)` steps. [AB09, §1.2; the composition that [AB09] leaves to
high-level descriptions.]

**Proof sketch.** `bufferedCompTM_computesInTime` gives `T₁ |x| + |f x| + 2 + T₂ |f x|`; the
intermediate word is no longer than the time that produced it (`output_length_le`), and
monotonicity of `T₂` turns `T₂ |f x|` into `T₂ (T₁ |x|)`. -/
theorem bufferedCompTM_computesFunInTime {M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool} {f g : List Bool → List Bool}
    {T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime g T₂)
    (hT₂ : Monotone T₂) :
    (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).ComputesFunInTime (g ∘ f) fun n => 2 * (T₁ n + T₂ (T₁ n) + 1) := by
  intro x
  have hlen : (f x).length ≤ T₁ x.length := by
    have ho := ((computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp (h₁ x)).2
    simpa only [ho] using M₁.tm.output_length_le x (T₁ x.length)
  have htime : T₂ (f x).length ≤ T₂ (T₁ x.length) := hT₂ hlen
  exact (bufferedCompTM_computesInTime M₁ M₂ (h₁ x) (h₂ (f x))).mono
    (by dsimp only; omega)

/-- **The buffered composition on the first machine's image** (landing:
`Turing.FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesFunInTime_on_image`, new in `Composition` before
`exists_comp_on_image`; proved, the row's body moved). If `M` computes `f` within `T₁` and, for
every input `x`, `U` maps `f x` to `g x` within `T₂ |x|` steps, then `bufferedCompTM M U`
computes `g` within `2·T₁ n + T₂ n + 2` steps. No totality of `U` and no monotonicity is
assumed.

**Proof sketch.** As `bufferedCompTM_computesFunInTime`, with the second phase's budget
measured at the original input length. -/
theorem bufferedCompTM_computesFunInTime_on_image (M U : FinTM Bool)
    (f g : List Bool → List Bool) (T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T₁)
    (hU : ∀ x, U.ComputesInTime (f x) (g x) (T₂ x.length)) :
    (bufferedCompTM M U).ComputesFunInTime g (fun n => 2 * T₁ n + T₂ n + 2) := by
  intro x
  have hlen : (f x).length ≤ T₁ x.length := by
    have ho := ((computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp (hM x)).2
    simpa only [ho] using M.tm.output_length_le x (T₁ x.length)
  exact (bufferedCompTM_computesInTime M U (hM x) (hU x)).mono (by dsimp only; omega)

/-- **The buffered composition's halting relation** (landing:
`Turing.FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computes_iff`, new in `Composition` before `exists_comp_partial`;
proved, the row's body moved). For all machines `M₁`, `M₂` and words `x`, `w`: the buffered
composition halts on `x` with output `w` if and only if `M₁` halts on `x` with some output `y`
and `M₂` halts on `y` with output `w`. No totality or time hypotheses.

**Proof sketch.** The body of today's `exists_comp_partial` (`Composition.lean:474`): a
divergent first phase keeps every composite configuration live (`bufferedFirstCfg_run`);
otherwise `bufferedComp_start` reaches the second phase with `M₂`'s initial configuration on the
virtual input `y`, and `bufferedSecondCfg_run` tracks `M₂` step for step in both directions. -/
theorem bufferedCompTM_computes_iff (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x w : List Bool) :
    (∃ t, (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x w t) ↔
      ∃ y : List Bool, (∃ t, M₁.ComputesInTime x y t) ∧ ∃ t, M₂.ComputesInTime y w t := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    -- A divergent first component would keep every composite configuration live.
    have hh : ∃ s, (M₁.tm.runFrom (M₁.tm.initCfg x) s).state = none := by
      by_contra h
      have hr := bufferedFirstCfg_run M₁ M₂ (M₁.tm.initCfg x) t
        (fun s _ hs => h ⟨s, hs⟩)
      rw [← bufferedFirstCfg_init] at hr
      have hc := ((computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp ht).1
      rw [hr] at hc
      simp only [bufferedFirstCfg, Option.some_ne_none] at hc
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hh
    let y := (M₁.tm.runFrom (M₁.tm.initCfg x) s).output
    have hy : M₁.ComputesInTime x y s := (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨hs, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, p, tapes, heads, _, ha⟩ := bufferedComp_start M₁ M₂ x y s hy
    -- Extend a completed run past the verified administrative prefix.
    have hc := (computesInTime_iff _ x w (a + t)).mp (ht.mono (by omega))
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, ha] at hc
    obtain ⟨b, _, hr⟩ := bufferedSecondCfg_run M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.initCfg y) true
      (by simp [VirtualTag, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]) p tapes heads t
    rw [hr] at hc
    refine ⟨y, ⟨s, hy⟩, t, (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ?_⟩
    exact ⟨by simpa only [bufferedSecondCfg, Option.map_eq_none_iff] using hc.1, hc.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨s, hs⟩, ⟨t, ht⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨a, p, tapes, heads, _, ha⟩ := bufferedComp_start M₁ M₂ x y s hs
    obtain ⟨b, _, hr⟩ := bufferedSecondCfg_run M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.initCfg y) true
      (by simp [VirtualTag, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]) p tapes heads t
    have hc := (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp ht
    refine ⟨a + t, (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ?_⟩
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, ha, hr]
    exact ⟨by simpa only [bufferedSecondCfg, Option.map_eq_none_iff] using hc.1, hc.2⟩

/-- **The untimed conditional** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.condTM`, made public in place at
`Composition.lean:517`, body unchanged). Run `D` with its first emission captured in a state
register, rewind the input, then enter `M₁` or `M₂` on disjoint fresh tapes according to the
register; an empty register at dispatch halts. -/
def condTM (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)
  State := (Option D.State × Option Bool) ⊕ (Option Bool ⊕ (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State))
  tm :=
    { q₀ := .inl (some D.tm.q₀, none)
      tr := fun q inp work => match q with
        | .inl (some q, reg) =>
          let a := D.tm.tr q inp (fun i => work (Fin.castAdd (M₁.k + M₂.k) i))
          ⟨a.inputTape, Fin.addCases a.workTapes (fun _ => (none, 0)), none,
            some (.inl (a.state, reg.or a.output))⟩
        | .inl (none, reg) => controlAction .neg (some (.inr (.inl reg)))
        | .inr (.inl reg) => match inp with
          | some _ => controlAction .neg (some (.inr (.inl reg)))
          | none => controlAction .pos
              (reg.map (fun b => .inr (.inr (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.q₀)))
        | .inr (.inr q) => rightAction D.k (fun s => .inr (.inr s))
            ((branchTM M₁ M₂ false).tm.tr q inp (fun i => work (Fin.natAdd D.k i))) }

/-- **The untimed conditional's halting relation** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.condTM_computes_iff`,
new in `Composition` before `exists_cond`). If `D` computes `x ↦ [p x]`, then on every input
`x` the conditional halts with output `w` if and only if the branch `cond (p x) M₁ M₂` halts on
`x` with output `w`.

**Proof sketch.** The body of today's `exists_cond` (`Composition.lean:654`): the private
`condTM_start` reaches the selected branch's initial configuration, after which `rightCfg_run`
tracks the branch union step for step and `branchTM_computes` identifies the selected branch. -/
theorem condTM_computes_iff (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (p : List Bool → Bool)
    (hD : D.Computes fun x => [p x]) (x w : List Bool) :
    (∃ t, (condTM D M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x w t) ↔
      ∃ t, (cond (p x) M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x w t := by
  sorry

/-- **Row** `Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_id`, statement unchanged. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_computesFunInTime_id : type_of% @Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_id :=
  ⟨idTM, 1, fun x => (idTM_computes x).mono (by simp)⟩

/-- **Row** `Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_const`, statement unchanged. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_computesFunInTime_const :
    type_of% @Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_const :=
  fun w => ⟨constTM w, w.length + 1, fun x =>
    (constTM_computes w x).mono (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.succ_pos _))⟩

/-- **Row** `Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_ifEq`, statement unchanged. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_computesFunInTime_ifEq : type_of% @Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_ifEq :=
  fun w₀ u v => ⟨ifEqTM w₀ u v, _, ifEqTM_computes w₀ u v⟩

/-- **Row** `Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_comp`, statement unchanged. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_computesFunInTime_comp : type_of% @Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_comp :=
  fun h₁ h₂ hT₂ => ⟨_, 2, bufferedCompTM_computesFunInTime h₁ h₂ hT₂⟩

/-- **Row** `Turing.FinTM.exists_comp_on_image`, statement unchanged. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_exists_comp_on_image : type_of% @Turing.FinTM.exists_comp_on_image :=
  fun M U f g T₁ T₂ hM hU => ⟨_, bufferedCompTM_computesFunInTime_on_image M U f g T₁ T₂ hM hU⟩

/-- **Row** `Turing.FinTM.exists_comp_partial`, statement unchanged. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_exists_comp_partial : type_of% @Turing.FinTM.exists_comp_partial :=
  fun M₁ M₂ => ⟨bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂, bufferedCompTM_computes_iff M₁ M₂⟩

/-- **Row** `Turing.FinTM.exists_cond`, statement unchanged. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_exists_cond : type_of% @Turing.FinTM.exists_cond :=
  fun D M₁ M₂ p hD => ⟨condTM D M₁ M₂, condTM_computes_iff D M₁ M₂ p hD⟩

end Turing.FinTM

/-! ════ Part 3. `Build/Wrappers.lean`: the timed conditional and its specs, the redirect
correspondence, and the row. -/
-- @landing TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Wrappers
-- @imports TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Wrappers
-- @imports TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Composition
-- @imports TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Simulation

namespace Turing.FinTM

-- @shim begin (verbatim from `Build/Wrappers.lean`; dropped on landing)
private def timedPadTM (D : FinTM Bool) (r : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM (D.k + r) Bool D.State where
  q₀ := D.tm.q₀
  tr q inp work := leftAction r id (D.tm.tr q inp (fun i => work (Fin.castAdd r i)))
-- @shim end

/-- **The timed conditional** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.timedCondTM`, made public in place at
`Build/Wrappers.lean:479`, body unchanged; today also copied into Catalog as `f2_timedCondTM`).
Run the decider `D` with its output captured on the last tape, step back to read the verdict,
rewind the input, then run `M₁` or `M₂`, as the verdict says, from its genuine initial
configuration on its own untouched tape bank (W3). The branch tapes are idle while `D` runs. -/
def timedCondTM (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := (D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)) + 1
  State := D.State ⊕ (Bool ⊕ ((Bool × Bool) ⊕ (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State)))
  tm :=
    { q₀ := .inl D.tm.q₀
      tr := fun q inp work => match q with
        | .inl q => captureAction Sum.inl (.inr (.inl false))
            ((timedPadTM D (M₁.k + M₂.k)).tr q inp (fun i => work i.castSucc))
        | .inr (.inl false) =>
          ⟨0, (fun i => if (i : ℕ) < D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k) then (none, 0)
            else (none, .neg)), none, some (.inr (.inl true))⟩
        | .inr (.inl true) => controlAction 0
            (some (.inr (.inr (.inl ((work (Fin.last _)).getD false, false)))))
        | .inr (.inr (.inl (b, false))) =>
            controlAction .neg (some (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, true)))))
        | .inr (.inr (.inl (b, true))) => match inp with
          | some _ => controlAction .neg (some (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, true)))))
          | none => controlAction .pos
              (some (.inr (.inr (.inr (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.q₀))))
        | .inr (.inr (.inr q)) => leftAction 1 id
            (rightAction D.k (fun s => .inr (.inr (.inr s)))
              ((branchTM M₁ M₂ false).tm.tr q inp
                (fun i => work (Fin.natAdd D.k i).castSucc))) }

/-- **The timed conditional's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.timedCondTM_computes`, new in
`Build/Wrappers.lean` before `computesFunInTime_cond`; statement verbatim from Catalog's private
`f2_cond_time`). If `D` computes the verdict `[p x]` within `T₀` and `M₁`, `M₂` compute `f₁`,
`f₂` within `T₁`, `T₂`, the timed conditional computes `if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x` within
`5·(T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1)` steps; no monotonicity is needed, since the selected branch
runs on the same physical input.

**Proof sketch.** The body of today's `computesFunInTime_cond` (`Build/Wrappers.lean:711`),
which `f2_cond_time` copies: the captured decider run, the two-step verdict read and the input
rewind take at most `2·T₀ + 5` steps (the private `timed_start`; the input head has moved at
most once per decider step), and the selected branch then runs from its own initial
configuration (`timed_branch_run`, `branchTM_computes`). -/
theorem timedCondTM_computes {D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool} {p : List Bool → Bool}
    {f₁ f₂ : List Bool → List Bool} {T₀ T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T₀)
    (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f₁ T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime f₂ T₂) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x)
      (fun n => 5 * (T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1)) := by
  sorry

/-- **The timed conditional's space** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.timedCondTM_spaceUsed`, new in
`Wrappers` after `timedCondTM_computes`; statement verbatim from Catalog's private
`f2_cond_space`, whose proof moves with its ledger). If `D` outputs `[b]` on `x` within `T`
steps, then at every time `t` the conditional's space is at most `D`'s space at time `T`, plus
the branch union's space at time `t`, plus two cells for the capture tape.

**Proof sketch.** Catalog's `f2_cond_space`: the three tape groups are disjoint. The decider
bank is touched only during the captured run, which halts by `T`; the branch bank only after
the dispatch, along the branch union's own trajectory; the capture head stays in `{0, 1}`. The
ledger `f2_cond_ledger` (moved with it) gives the head positions of the three groups at every
time. -/
theorem timedCondTM_spaceUsed (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T t : ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.spaceUsed ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) t ≤
      D.tm.spaceUsed (D.tm.initCfg x) T +
        (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.spaceUsed ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) t + 2 := by
  sorry

/-- **The redirect correspondence** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_runFrom`, new in
`Wrappers` after `redirectTM_live`; the public field form of today's private `redirect_run`).
At every time `t`, the redirected machine's configuration on `x` has the source run's input
position, work tapes and work heads, an empty output, and the state that the source state and
the source's last emitted bit determine: the source state with that bit while the source is
live; after the source halts, halted if the bit is `haltOn`, and the stationary live loop
otherwise.

**Proof sketch.** Rewrite with the private `redirect_run`, which states that the run is the
image of the source run under the private `redirectCfg`; each conjunct is then a field of that
image, by `rfl`. -/
theorem redirectTM_runFrom (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).state =
        (match (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).state with
          | some s => some (.inl (s, (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).output.getLast?))
          | none =>
            if (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).output.getLast? = some haltOn then none
            else some (.inr ())) ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).inputPos =
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).inputPos ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).workTapes =
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).workTapes ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos =
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).output = [] := by
  sorry

/-- **Row** `Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond`, statement unchanged. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_computesFunInTime_cond : type_of% @Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond :=
  fun hD h₁ h₂ => ⟨_, 5, timedCondTM_computes hD h₁ h₂⟩

end Turing.FinTM

/-! ════ Part 4. `TuringMachine/Encoding.lean`: the diagonal pairing machine, the code-normal
form, and the two rows. -/
-- @landing TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Encoding
-- @imports TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Encoding
-- @imports TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Simulation

namespace Turing

/-- **The diagonal pairing machine** (landing: `Turing.pairDiagTM`, made public in place at
`TuringMachine/Encoding.lean:299`, body unchanged). A six-state machine with no work tapes that,
on input `α`, writes each symbol of `α` twice, then the separator `false, true`, rewinds the
input, and copies `α` once more, so that it outputs `pairEncode α α`. It is also the witness of
`Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairDup` (consolidation: Primitives' private `pairDupTM`, which
computes the same function, retires). [AB09, proof of Theorem 1.11: the self-application input
of the `HALT` reduction] -/
def pairDiagTM : FinTM Bool where
  k := 0
  State := Fin 6
  tm :=
    { q₀ := 0
      tr := fun q inp _ =>
        match q with
        | 0 => match inp with
          | some b => ⟨.zero, fun i => i.elim0, some b, some 1⟩
          | none => ⟨.zero, fun i => i.elim0, some false, some 2⟩
        | 1 => ⟨.pos, fun i => i.elim0, inp, some 0⟩
        | 2 => ⟨.zero, fun i => i.elim0, some true, some 3⟩
        | 3 => ⟨.neg, fun i => i.elim0, none, some 4⟩
        | 4 => match inp with
          | some _ => ⟨.neg, fun i => i.elim0, none, some 4⟩
          | none => ⟨.pos, fun i => i.elim0, none, some 5⟩
        | _ => match inp with
          | some b => ⟨.pos, fun i => i.elim0, some b, some 5⟩
          | none => ⟨.zero, fun i => i.elim0, none, none⟩ }

/-- **The diagonal pairing machine's time** (landing: `Turing.pairDiagTM_computes`, new in
`Encoding` before `computesFunInTime_pairEncode_diag`). On input `α` the diagonal pairing
machine halts within `4|α| + 5` steps with output `pairEncode α α`.

**Proof sketch.** The `have h` of today's `computesFunInTime_pairEncode_diag`
(`Encoding.lean:491`), from the private `pairDiag_run`: the doubling pass takes `2|α|` steps,
the two separator steps and the first left move `3`, the rewind `|α| + 1`, the copy `|α|`, and
the halting transition `1`. -/
theorem pairDiagTM_computes (x : List Bool) :
    pairDiagTM.ComputesInTime x (pairEncode x x) (4 * x.length + 5) := by
  sorry

/-- **The code normal form of a one-work-tape machine** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.toCodeTM`, new
in `Encoding` before `exists_codeTM`; the body is the witness term of today's `exists_codeTM`,
`Encoding.lean:618-627`). For a binary machine `M` with one work tape, the coded machine with
`|Q| - 1` as its state index bound, whose transition function is `M`'s transported along the
canonical bijection `Q ≃ Fin |Q|` (`Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq`; `Q` is inhabited by the start
state). [AB09, §1.4] Noncomputable, through `Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq`. -/
noncomputable def FinTM.toCodeTM : (M : FinTM Bool) → M.k = 1 → CodeTM
  | @FinTM.mk _ _ Q hQ dQ tm, rfl =>
    letI : Fintype Q := hQ
    letI : DecidableEq Q := dQ
    have hcard : Fintype.card Q = (Fintype.card Q - 1) + 1 := by
      have : 0 < Fintype.card Q := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨tm.q₀⟩
      omega
    let e := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hcard
    ⟨Fintype.card Q - 1, tm.relabelState e⟩

/-- **The code normal form is equivalent** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.toCodeTM_computesInTime_iff`,
new in `Encoding`; proved, the row's body moved). For a one-work-tape binary machine `M`, its
code normal form halts on `x` with output `w` within `t` steps if and only if `M` does.
[AB09, §1.4]

**Proof sketch.** The relabelled machine's run is the image of `M`'s run under the state
bijection (`Turing.MultiTapeTM.relabelState_runFrom_init`); halting and output are preserved. -/
theorem FinTM.toCodeTM_computesInTime_iff (M : FinTM Bool) (hk : M.k = 1)
    (x output : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (M.toCodeTM hk).toFinTM.ComputesInTime x output t ↔ M.ComputesInTime x output t := by
  rcases M with @⟨k, Q, hQ, dQ, tm⟩
  dsimp only at hk
  subst k
  simp only [FinTM.toCodeTM, CodeTM.toFinTM, FinTM.ComputesInTime,
    MultiTapeTM.ComputesInTimeAndSpace, MultiTapeTM.relabelState_runFrom_init, Cfg.mapState,
    Option.map_eq_none_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hhalt, hout, -⟩
    exact ⟨_, hhalt, hout, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, hhalt, hout, -⟩
    exact ⟨_, hhalt, hout, rfl⟩

/-- **Row** `Turing.computesFunInTime_pairEncode_diag`, statement unchanged. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_computesFunInTime_pairEncode_diag :
    type_of% @Turing.computesFunInTime_pairEncode_diag :=
  ⟨pairDiagTM, 6, fun x => (pairDiagTM_computes x).mono (by simp; omega)⟩

/-- **Row** `Turing.exists_codeTM`, statement unchanged. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_exists_codeTM : type_of% @Turing.exists_codeTM :=
  fun M hk => ⟨M.toCodeTM hk, FinTM.toCodeTM_computesInTime_iff M hk⟩

end Turing

/-! ════ Part 5. `ClassP/TimeConstructible.lean`: the binary length counter under its
`Turing.FinTM` name, its specs, and `timeConstructible_id`. -/
-- @landing TCSlib.Complexity.ClassP.TimeConstructible
-- @imports TCSlib.Complexity.ClassP.TimeConstructible
-- @imports TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Encoding
-- @imports TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Simulation

namespace Complexity

open Turing

-- @shim begin (verbatim from `ClassP/TimeConstructible.lean`; dropped on landing)
private def counterBump (d : SignType) (w : Option Bool) : Action 1 Bool (Fin 4) :=
  if w = some true then
    ⟨d, fun _ => (some (some false), .pos), none, some 1⟩
  else ⟨d, fun _ => (some (some true), .neg), none, some 2⟩
-- @shim end

/-- **The binary length counter** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM`, made public in place
at `ClassP/TimeConstructible.lean:130` as `_root_.Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM`, body unchanged;
today the private `Complexity.counterTM`, copied into Catalog as `f2_counterTM`). A
one-work-tape machine with four states (count `0`, carry `1`, rewind `2`, emit `3`) that keeps a
little-endian binary counter on its work tape, increments it once per input symbol, and on the
blank after the input emits the counter's bits and halts, so that it computes
`x ↦ Nat.bits |x|`. [AB09, §1.3, the examples of time-constructible functions] It is declared
under its `Turing.FinTM` name so that MIG-9 can move it into `Build/` without a rename. -/
def _root_.Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM : FinTM Bool where
  k := 1
  State := Fin 4
  tm :=
    { q₀ := 0
      tr := fun q inp work =>
        if q = 0 then
          match inp with
          | none => ⟨.zero, fun _ => (none, .zero), none, some 3⟩
          | some _ => counterBump .pos (work 0)
        else if q = 1 then counterBump .zero (work 0)
        else if q = 2 then
          match work 0 with
          | none => ⟨.zero, fun _ => (none, .pos), none, some 0⟩
          | some _ => ⟨.zero, fun _ => (none, .neg), none, some 2⟩
        else
          match work 0 with
          | none => ⟨.zero, fun _ => (none, .zero), none, none⟩
          | some b => ⟨.zero, fun _ => (none, .pos), some b, some 3⟩ }

/-- **The length counter's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM_computes`, new in
`TimeConstructible` before `timeConstructible_id`; statement verbatim from Catalog's private
`f2_counter_computes`). The counter computes `x ↦ Nat.bits |x|` within `5·(n + 1)` steps.
[AB09, §1.3]

**Proof sketch.** The body of today's `timeConstructible_id` (`TimeConstructible.lean:422`),
which `f2_counter_computes` copies: with twice the number of `true` counter bits as potential,
elapsed time plus potential is at most `4n` after `n` increments (the private `counter_count`);
entering emission and the final halt add two steps, and the emitted word, of length at most
`n`, costs one step per bit. -/
theorem _root_.Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM_computes : FinTM.lengthBitsTM.ComputesFunInTime
    (fun x => Nat.bits x.length) (fun n => 5 * (n + 1)) := by
  sorry

/-- **The length counter's space** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM_spaceUsed`, new in
`TimeConstructible`; statement verbatim from Catalog's private `f2_counter_space`, whose proof
moves with `f2_counter_count_space` and `f2_counter_heads`). At every time, the counter's work
tape has visited at most `5·(Nat.size |x| + 1)` cells: logarithmic space.

**Proof sketch.** Catalog's `f2_counter_space`: every counting round returns the head to the
origin, a carry walks at most the counter's binary width, which never exceeds `Nat.size |x|`,
and emission walks the stored word once, so at every time the head stays in an interval of at
most `5·(Nat.size |x| + 1)` cells (the head ledger `f2_counter_heads`, from the increment
ledger `f2_counter_count_space`). -/
theorem _root_.Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM_spaceUsed (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.spaceUsed (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.initCfg x) t ≤
      5 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) := by
  sorry

/-- **Row** `Complexity.timeConstructible_id`, statement unchanged. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_timeConstructible_id : type_of% @Complexity.timeConstructible_id :=
  ⟨fun n => le_refl n, 5, by decide, FinTM.lengthBitsTM, FinTM.lengthBitsTM_computes⟩

end Complexity

/-! ════ Part 6. `Build/Loop.lean`: the loop host, the emitting loop and the clean call, their
specs, and the six rows. -/
-- @landing TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Loop
-- @imports TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Loop
-- @imports TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Wrappers
-- @imports TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Composition
-- @imports TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Simulation

namespace Turing.FinTM

-- @shim begin (verbatim from `Build/Loop.lean`; dropped on landing)
private def loopBodyTM (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) : FinTM Bool where
  k := body.k + 1
  State := body.State × Bool
  tm :=
    { q₀ := (body.tm.q₀, false)
      tr := fun q inp work =>
        if q.1 = anchor ∧ q.2 = false then
          { inputTape := 0
            workTapes := fun i =>
              if (i : ℕ) < body.k then (none, 0) else (some (some false), 0)
            output := none
            state := none }
        else
          let a := body.tm.tr q.1 inp (fun i => work i.castSucc)
          { inputTape := a.inputTape
            workTapes := fun i =>
              if h : (i : ℕ) < body.k then a.workTapes ⟨i, h⟩
              else (if a.state = none then some (some true) else none, 0)
            output := a.output
            state := a.state.map (fun s => (s, false)) } }

private abbrev LoopHostState (body F : FinTM Bool) :=
  F.State ⊕ ((Bool × (body.State × Bool)) ⊕ Fin 14)

private def loopFuelSource (body F : FinTM Bool) :
    MultiTapeTM (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) Bool F.State where
  q₀ := F.tm.q₀
  tr := fun q inp work =>
    rightAction (body.k + 1) id (rightAction 1 id
      (F.tm.tr q inp fun i => work (Fin.natAdd (body.k + 1) (Fin.natAdd 1 i))))

private def loopBodySource (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) :
    MultiTapeTM (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) Bool (body.State × Bool) where
  q₀ := (body.tm.q₀, false)
  tr := fun q inp work => leftAction (1 + F.k) id
    ((loopBodyTM body anchor).tm.tr q inp fun i => work (Fin.castAdd (1 + F.k) i))

private def loopControlAction (body F : FinTM Bool) (inp : SignType)
    (flag : Option (Option Bool)) (counter payload : Option (Option Bool) × SignType)
    (out : Option Bool) (next : Option (LoopHostState body F)) :
    Action (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) where
  inputTape := inp
  workTapes := fun i =>
    if (i : ℕ) = body.k then (flag, 0)
    else if (i : ℕ) = body.k + 1 then counter
    else if (i : ℕ) = body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) then payload
    else (none, 0)
  output := out
  state := next

private def loopBodyDispatch (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward : Bool)
    (startup : Bool) (s : body.State × Bool) (inp : Option Bool)
    (work : Fin (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) → Option Bool) :
    Action (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) :=
  bif forward then
    leftAction 1 id (Turing.emitAction (fun s => .inr (.inl (startup, s)))
      (.inr (.inr (if startup then 6 else 7)))
      ((loopBodySource body F anchor).tr s inp (fun i => work i.castSucc)))
  else
    captureAction (fun s => .inr (.inl (startup, s)))
      (.inr (.inr (if startup then 6 else 7)))
      ((loopBodySource body F anchor).tr s inp fun i => work i.castSucc)

private def loopHostM (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward findMode : Bool) :
    FinTM Bool where
  k := body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1
  State := LoopHostState body F
  tm :=
    { q₀ := .inl F.tm.q₀
      tr := fun q inp work =>
        let ctrl (j : Fin 14) : LoopHostState body F := .inr (.inr j)
        let call (startup : Bool) (s : body.State × Bool) : LoopHostState body F :=
          .inr (.inl (startup, s))
        let flag : Fin (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) := ⟨body.k, by omega⟩
        let counter : Fin (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) := ⟨body.k + 1, by omega⟩
        let payload := Fin.last (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k))
        let act := loopControlAction body F
        match q with
        | .inl s => captureAction Sum.inl (ctrl 0)
            ((loopFuelSource body F).tr s inp fun i => work i.castSucc)
        | .inr (.inl (startup, s)) => loopBodyDispatch body F anchor forward startup s inp work
        | .inr (.inr phase) =>
            if phase = 0 then act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 1))
            else if phase = 1 then
              match work payload with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 1))
              | none => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .pos) none (some (ctrl 2))
            else if phase = 2 then
              match work payload with
              | some b => act 0 none (some (some b), .pos) (some none, .pos) none
                  (some (ctrl 2))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 3))
            else if phase = 3 then
              match work counter with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 3))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .pos) (none, .pos) none (some (ctrl 4))
            else if phase = 4 then act .neg none (none, 0) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 5))
            else if phase = 5 then
              match inp with
              | some _ => act .neg none (none, 0) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 5))
              | none => act .pos none (none, 0) (none, 0) none
                  (some (call true (body.tm.q₀, false)))
            else if phase = 6 then act 0 (some none) (none, 0) (none, 0) none
              (some (call false (anchor, true)))
            else if phase = 7 then
              if work flag = some true then
                if findMode then act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 12))
                else act 0 none (none, 0) (none, 0) (some true) none
              else act 0 (some none) (none, 0) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 8))
            else if phase = 8 then
              match work counter with
              | some false => act 0 none (some (some true), .pos) (none, 0) none
                  (some (ctrl 8))
              | some true => act 0 none (some (some false), .neg) (none, 0) none
                  (some (ctrl 9))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 10))
            else if phase = 9 then
              match work counter with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 9))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .pos) (none, 0) none
                  (some (call false (anchor, true)))
            else if phase = 10 then
              match work counter with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 10))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .pos) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 11))
            else if phase = 11 then
              act 0 none (none, 0) (none, 0) (if findMode then none else some false) none
            else if phase = 12 then
              match work payload with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 12))
              | none => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .pos) none (some (ctrl 13))
            else
              match work payload with
              | some b => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .pos) (some b) (some (ctrl 13))
              | none => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, 0) none none }
-- @shim end

/-- **The loop host** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.loopHostTM`, made public in place at
`Build/Loop.lean:649`, today the private abbreviation `loopHost`, body unchanged; Catalog holds
an older copy, `f2_loopHost`, from before the forwarding flag). The decision and find host of
the bounded loop: it runs the fuel machine `F` with its output captured, copies the fuel word
`Nat.bits R` into a fixed-width counter, rewinds, starts `body`, and then alternates captured
body rounds from the `anchor` seam with fixed-width debits of the counter (the first anchor
entry is free). An accepting round halts with `[true]`, or in find mode replays the round's own
output; underflow of the counter halts with `[false]`, or with nothing in find mode. It is the
non-forwarding instance `loopHostM body F anchor false findMode` of the shared controller. -/
abbrev loopHostTM (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (findMode : Bool) :
    FinTM Bool := loopHostM body F anchor false findMode

/-- **The loop host's configuration contract** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.loopHostTM_contracts`,
new in `Loop` after `loopHost_contracts`). Given a fuel machine for `Nat.bits (R |x|)` within
`T`, an invariant `Inv` that holds at `s0 x` and is preserved by `stepF`, a body startup that
reaches the `anchor` seam of `s0 x` within `T |x|` without visiting the anchor earlier, and body
rounds that, from the seam of an invariant word `s`, take positive time at most `T |x|`, do not
revisit the anchor in between, and either halt with output `out x s` (when `acceptF x s`) or
reach the seam of `stepF x s`: then for every input `x` the host has a family `cfg` of round
configurations with a startup of at most `10·(T |x| + 1)` steps reaching `cfg 0`, empty output
at rounds `0, …, R |x|`, a halted terminal `cfg (R |x| + 1)` with output `[false]` (`[]` in
find mode), and, for each round `i ≤ R |x|`, a segment of at most `10·(T |x| + 1)` steps that
halts with output `[true]` (the round's output in find mode) if orbit point `i` is accepted,
and otherwise reaches `cfg (i + 1)`. The coefficient `10` is today's `loopHost_bound`.

**Proof sketch.** Today's private `loopHost_contracts` (`Build/Loop.lean:2066`), whose proof
opens with `refine ⟨loopHost_bound, ?_⟩`, `loopHost_bound = max 1 (max 9 (3 + 2 + 5)) = 10`:
the fuel phase and the body startup give the startup (`loopHost_prepare`, `loopHost_start`);
each segment is one captured body round followed by a debit and rewind of the counter, whose
width never exceeds `T |x|` (`loop_fuel_width`), so every phase costs a constant multiple of
`T |x| + 1` (`loopHost_round`); the last debit underflows into the terminal. -/
theorem loopHostTM_contracts (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)
    (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (findMode : Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if acceptF x s then
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state
              = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output
              = out x s
        else
          body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) :
    ∀ x : List Bool,
      ∃ (cfg : ℕ → Cfg (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).k Bool
          (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).State x) (startup : ℕ),
        startup ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1) ∧
        (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
          ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.initCfg x) startup = cfg 0 ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, (cfg i).output = []) ∧
        (cfg (R x.length + 1)).state = none ∧
        (cfg (R x.length + 1)).output = (if findMode then [] else [false]) ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, ∃ t ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1),
          if acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) then
            ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).state = none ∧
            ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).output =
              (if findMode then out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) else [true])
          else (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t = cfg (i + 1)) := by
  sorry

/-- **The decision loop's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.loopHostTM_decides`, new in `Loop`
before `exists_loopTM`). Under the hypotheses of `loopHostTM_contracts` with accepting output
`[true]`, the host in decision mode outputs `[true]` if some orbit point `(stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)`
with `i ≤ R |x|` is accepted, and `[false]` otherwise, within `10·(T n + 1)·(R n + 2)` steps.

**Proof sketch.** The body of today's `exists_loopTM` (`Build/Loop.lean:2370`) with `c = 10`:
the contract family's startup and at most `R |x| + 1` segments sum, by the private
already-halted-terminal summation lemma `loop_halted_run`, to at most
`10·(T |x| + 1) + (R |x| + 1)·10·(T |x| + 1)` steps. -/
theorem loopHostTM_decides (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if acceptF x s then
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state
              = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output
              = [true]
        else
          body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) :
    (loopHostTM body F anchor false).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => [(List.range (R x.length + 1)).any
        fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))])
      (fun n => 10 * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2)) := by
  sorry

/-- **The find loop's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.loopHostTM_finds`, new in `Loop` before
`exists_loopFindTM`). Under the hypotheses of `loopHostTM_contracts`, the host in find mode
outputs `out x s` for the first accepted orbit point `s = (stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)` with
`i ≤ R |x|`, and `[]` if there is none, within `10·(T n + 1)·(R n + 2)` steps.

**Proof sketch.** The body of today's `exists_loopFindTM` (`Build/Loop.lean:2484`) with
`c = 10`: sum the contract family's segments with the private first-accept summation lemma
`loop_find_run`. -/
theorem loopHostTM_finds (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)
    (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if acceptF x s then
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state
              = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output
              = out x s
        else
          body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) :
    (loopHostTM body F anchor true).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => match (List.range (R x.length + 1)).find?
          (fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))) with
        | some i => out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))
        | none => [])
      (fun n => 10 * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2)) := by
  sorry

/-- **The loop host's space budget** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.loopHostTM_spaceUsed_le_budget`, new
in `Loop` after `loopHostTM_finds`). Under the hypotheses of `loopHostTM_contracts`, in either
mode, at every time the host has visited at most `23·k·(T |x| + 1)` work cells, where `k` is its
tape count: space is bounded by the per-round time budget and does not grow with the number of
rounds `R |x|`.

**Proof sketch.** The space half of Catalog's private `f2_exists_loopFind_space`
(`Build/Catalog.lean:8411`), which uses no find-mode fact: the extended contract
`f2_loopHost_contracts` (it replaces `loopHost_contracts`, moved and re-targeted) also bounds
every seam's heads by `T |x|` and the terminal's by `T |x| + 10·(T |x| + 1)`; each segment
lasts at most `10·(T |x| + 1)` steps, so by `f2_seamed_space` (moved, with `f2_segment_heads`
and `f2_space_radius`) every head stays within `T |x| + 10·(T |x| + 1)` of the origin at every
time, and each tape visits at most `2·(11·T |x| + 10) + 1 ≤ 23·(T |x| + 1)` cells. -/
theorem loopHostTM_spaceUsed_le_budget (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)
    (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (findMode : Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if acceptF x s then
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state
              = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output
              = out x s
        else
          body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s)))
    (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.spaceUsed
        ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.initCfg x) t
      ≤ 23 * (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).k * (T x.length + 1) := by
  sorry

-- @shim begin (verbatim from `Build/Loop.lean`; dropped on landing)
private abbrev emLoopHost (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (findMode : Bool) :
    FinTM Bool := loopHostM body F anchor true findMode
-- @shim end

/-- **The emitting loop** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.emitLoopTM`, new in `Loop` after the private
`emLoopHost`; the body is the witness term of today's `exists_emitLoopTM`, `Loop.lean:4822`).
The forwarding instance of the shared loop controller in find mode: the same fuel capture,
counter and seam discipline as `loopHostTM`, with each body round's emissions forwarded to the
physical output instead of captured, and no exhaustion verdict, so that the machine outputs the
concatenation of the rounds' chunks. -/
abbrev emitLoopTM (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) : FinTM Bool :=
  emLoopHost body F anchor true

/-- **The emitting loop's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.emitLoopTM_computes`, new in `Loop`
before `exists_emitLoopTM`). Under the hypotheses of `exists_emitLoopTM` (fuel, invariant,
startup, and rounds that advance to the stepped seam in positive time at most `T |x|` while
emitting exactly `emitF x s`), the emitting loop outputs the concatenation of
`emitF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))` over `i = 0, …, R |x|` within `10·(T n + 1)·(R n + 2)` steps.

**Proof sketch.** The body of today's `exists_emitLoopTM` (`Build/Loop.lean:4775`), which fixes
`c = 10`: the fuel preparation and the body startup take at most `10·(T |x| + 1)` steps
(`loopHost_prepare`, `loopHost_start`); each round, its anchor stop and its debit take at most
`10·(T |x| + 1)` (`emLoopHost_round`); the prefix-summation lemma `emLoop_sum` concatenates the
`R |x| + 1` chunks. -/
theorem emitLoopTM_computes (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF emitF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        body.tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
            { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))
                with output := emitF x s }) :
    (emitLoopTM body F anchor).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => (List.range (R x.length + 1)).flatMap
        (fun i => emitF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))))
      (fun n => 10 * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2)) := by
  sorry

-- @shim begin (verbatim from `Build/Loop.lean`; dropped on landing)
private def emCallIdleTM : FinTM Bool where
  k := 0
  State := Unit
  tm := ⟨(), fun _ _ _ => controlAction 0 none⟩

private def emCallEvalTM (M : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := (bufferedCompTM emCallIdleTM M).k + 1
  State := (bufferedCompTM emCallIdleTM M).State ⊕ Unit
  tm := {
    q₀ := .inl (bufferedCompTM emCallIdleTM M).tm.q₀
    tr := fun q inp work => match q with
      | .inl q => captureAction Sum.inl (.inr ())
          ((bufferedCompTM emCallIdleTM M).tm.tr q inp (fun i => work i.castSucc))
      | .inr () => controlAction 0 (some (.inr ())) }

private def emCallClearTM : FinTM Bool where
  k := 3
  State := Fin 4
  tm := {
    q₀ := 0
    tr := fun q _ work => match q.val with
      | 0 => if work 1 = none then
          ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .pos), none, some 1⟩
        else ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .neg), none, some 0⟩
      | 1 => if work 1 = none then
          ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .neg), none, some 2⟩
        else ⟨0, fun i => (if i = 2 then none else some none, .pos), none, some 1⟩
      | 2 => if work 2 = none then
          ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .neg), none, some 2⟩
        else ⟨0, fun i => (if i = 2 then some none else none, 0), none, some 3⟩
      | _ => controlAction 0 (some 3) }

private def emCallSlots {α : Type} {k : ℕ} (data marks origin : Fin k → α) :
    Fin (k + (k + k)) → α := Fin.addCases data (Fin.addCases marks origin)

private def emCallTrackTM (M : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := M.k + (M.k + M.k)
  State := M.State ⊕ (Option M.State ⊕ Unit)
  tm := {
    q₀ := .inr (.inr ())
    tr := fun q inp work => match q with
      | .inr (.inr ()) =>
        ⟨0, emCallSlots (fun _ => (none, 0))
          (fun _ => (some (some true), 0)) (fun _ => (some (some true), 0)),
          none, some (.inl M.tm.q₀)⟩
      | .inl q =>
        let a := M.tm.tr q inp (fun i => work (Fin.castAdd (M.k + M.k) i))
        ⟨a.inputTape, emCallSlots a.workTapes
          (fun i => (none, (a.workTapes i).2)) (fun i => (none, (a.workTapes i).2)),
          a.output, some (.inr (.inl a.state))⟩
      | .inr (.inl next) =>
        ⟨0, emCallSlots (fun _ => (none, 0))
          (fun _ => (some (some true), 0)) (fun _ => (none, 0)),
          none, next.map Sum.inl⟩ }

private def emCallRightTM (M : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := M.k
  State := M.State ⊕ Bool
  tm := {
    q₀ := .inl M.tm.q₀
    tr := fun q inp work => match q with
      | .inl q =>
        let a := M.tm.tr q inp work
        { a with state := some ((a.state.map Sum.inl).getD (.inr false)) }
      | .inr false => controlAction .pos (some (.inr true))
      | .inr true => match inp with
        | some _ => controlAction .pos (some (.inr true))
        | none => controlAction 0 none }

private def emCallFinishTM (emit : Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := 2
  State := Fin 6
  tm := {
    q₀ := 0
    tr := fun q _ work => match q.val with
      | 0 => ⟨0, fun i => (none, if i = 0 then .neg else 0), none, some 1⟩
      | 1 => match work 0 with
        | some _ => ⟨0, fun i =>
            (if i = 0 ∧ emit = false then some none else none,
              if i = 0 then .neg else 0), none, some 1⟩
        | none => ⟨0, fun i => (none, if i = 0 then .pos else .neg), none, some 2⟩
      | 2 => match work 1 with
        | some _ => ⟨0, fun i => (none, if i = 0 then 0 else .neg), none, some 2⟩
        | none => ⟨0, fun i => (none, if i = 0 then 0 else .pos), none, some 3⟩
      | 3 => match work 1 with
        | some b => ⟨0, fun i =>
            (if i = 0 ∧ emit = false then some (some b) else none,
              if i = 0 ∧ emit = true then 0 else .pos),
            if emit then some b else none, some 3⟩
        | none => ⟨0, fun i =>
            (none, if i = 0 ∧ emit = true then 0 else .neg), none, some 4⟩
      | 4 => match work 1 with
        | some _ => ⟨0, fun i => (if i = 0 then none else some none,
            if i = 0 ∧ emit = true then 0 else .neg), none, some 4⟩
        | none => ⟨0, fun i =>
            (none, if i = 0 ∧ emit = true then 0 else .pos), none, some 5⟩
      | _ => controlAction 0 (some 5) }

private abbrev emCallSource (M : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool :=
  emCallEvalTM (emCallRightTM (emCallTrackTM M))

private abbrev emCallState (M : FinTM Bool) :=
  (emCallSource M).State ⊕ ((Fin (M.k + 1) × Fin 4) ⊕ Fin 6)

private def emCallTripleIndex (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin M.k) (r : Fin 3) :
    Fin (emCallSource M).k :=
  match r.val with
  | 0 => ⟨1 + i.val, by have := i.isLt; dsimp [emCallSource, emCallEvalTM,
      bufferedCompTM, emCallIdleTM, emCallRightTM, emCallTrackTM]; omega⟩
  | 1 => ⟨1 + M.k + i.val, by have := i.isLt; dsimp [emCallSource, emCallEvalTM,
      bufferedCompTM, emCallIdleTM, emCallRightTM, emCallTrackTM]; omega⟩
  | _ => ⟨1 + M.k + M.k + i.val, by have := i.isLt; dsimp [emCallSource, emCallEvalTM,
      bufferedCompTM, emCallIdleTM, emCallRightTM, emCallTrackTM]; omega⟩

private def emCallTripleSelect (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin M.k)
    (j : Fin (emCallSource M).k) : Option (Fin 3) :=
  if j.val = 1 + i.val then some 0 else
  if j.val = 1 + M.k + i.val then some 1 else
  if j.val = 1 + M.k + M.k + i.val then some 2 else none

private lemma emCall_triple_inverse (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin M.k) (r : Fin 3) :
    emCallTripleSelect M i (emCallTripleIndex M i r) = some r := by
  have hk : 0 < M.k := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt
  fin_cases r <;> simp [emCallTripleSelect, emCallTripleIndex, show M.k ≠ 0 by omega]
  all_goals repeat first | rfl | omega | split
  all_goals repeat first | rfl | omega | split

private def emCallPairIndex (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin 2) : Fin (emCallSource M).k :=
  if i = 0 then ⟨0, by dsimp [emCallSource, emCallEvalTM]; omega⟩
  else Fin.last (bufferedCompTM emCallIdleTM (emCallRightTM (emCallTrackTM M))).k

private def emCallPairSelect (M : FinTM Bool) (j : Fin (emCallSource M).k) :
    Option (Fin 2) :=
  if j.val = 0 then some 0 else
  if j.val = (bufferedCompTM emCallIdleTM (emCallRightTM (emCallTrackTM M))).k
    then some 1 else none

private lemma emCall_pair_inverse (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin 2) :
    emCallPairSelect M (emCallPairIndex M i) = some i := by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [emCallPairIndex, emCallPairSelect, emCallIdleTM,
    bufferedCompTM, emCallRightTM, emCallTrackTM]

private def emCallTripleEmbedding (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin M.k) :
    Fin 3 ↪ Fin (emCallSource M).k :=
  ⟨emCallTripleIndex M i, by
    intro a b h
    have he := congrArg (emCallTripleSelect M i) h
    simpa only [emCall_triple_inverse, Option.some.injEq] using he⟩

private def emCallPairEmbedding (M : FinTM Bool) : Fin 2 ↪ Fin (emCallSource M).k :=
  ⟨emCallPairIndex M, by
    intro a b h
    have he := congrArg (emCallPairSelect M) h
    simpa only [emCall_pair_inverse, Option.some.injEq] using he⟩
-- @shim end

/-- **The clean call** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.callTM`, made public in place at
`Build/Loop.lean:3897`, today the private `emCallTM`, body unchanged). From the entry seam holding
an argument word on tape `0`, it runs `M` on that argument through tracked banks with `M`'s
output captured, clears every bank to its observed extent, and then either installs the result
in place of the argument (`emit = false`) or forwards it to the physical output and keeps the
argument (`emit = true`), erases its administrative storage, and enters its exit state. -/
def callTM (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := (emCallSource M).k
  State := emCallState M
  tm := {
    q₀ := .inl (.inl (.inr (.inr ((emCallRightTM (emCallTrackTM M)).tm.q₀, true))))
    tr := fun q inp work => match q with
      | .inl q =>
        if q = .inr () then controlAction 0 (some (.inr (.inl (0, 0))))
        else ((embedEmitTM (Function.Embedding.refl _) (emCallSource M).tm).tr
          q inp work).mapState Sum.inl
      | .inr (.inl (i, q)) =>
        if hi : i.val < M.k then
          if q = 3 then controlAction 0 (some (.inr (.inl (⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩, 0))))
          else ((embedEmitTM (emCallTripleEmbedding M ⟨i.val, hi⟩) emCallClearTM.tm).tr
            q inp work).mapState
            (fun s => .inr (.inl (i, s)))
        else controlAction 0 (some (.inr (.inr 0)))
      | .inr (.inr q) => ((embedEmitTM (emCallPairEmbedding M) (emCallFinishTM emit).tm).tr
          q inp work).mapState
          (fun s => .inr (.inr s)) }

/-- **The clean call's entry state** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.callEntry`, new in `Loop` after
`callTM`; today the anonymous `(emCallTM M emit).tm.q₀` of `exists_installCallTM`). The start
state of the clean call. -/
def callEntry (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : (callTM M emit).State := (callTM M emit).tm.q₀

/-- **The clean call's exit state** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.callExit`, new in `Loop` after
`callEntry`; today the anonymous `.inr (.inr 5)` of `exists_installCallTM`). The absorbing
exit anchor of the finishing phase; it is a different summand of the state type from
`callEntry`. -/
def callExit (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : (callTM M emit).State := .inr (.inr 5)

/-- **The clean call has a tape** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.callTM_k_pos`, new in `Loop`). The
clean call's tape count is positive, so its argument seam lives on a genuine tape.

**Proof sketch.** The layout's tape count is a successor; `Nat.zero_lt_succ`. -/
theorem callTM_k_pos (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : 0 < (callTM M emit).k :=
  Nat.zero_lt_succ _

/-- **The clean call's run** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.callTM_run`, new in `Loop` before
`exists_installCallTM`; today's private `emCall_first`, `Build/Loop.lean:4592`, with the two
anchor states named). If `M` halts on `arg` with output `cap` within `T` steps, then from the
entry seam holding `arg`, over any native input `x`, the clean call first enters its exit state
at a positive time `t ≤ (24 + 13·k_M)·(T + |arg| + |cap| + 1)`, and does not visit it at any
earlier time, including time `0`; at `t` it is at the exit seam holding `cap` with empty output
(install mode), or holding `arg` with output `cap` (emit mode).

**Proof sketch.** `emCall_first` itself: `callEntry` and `callExit` unfold to the states that it
names. Its proof is the completion lemma `emCall_complete` (evaluation through tracked banks,
bank clearing, install or replay, capture erasure and rewinds, within the ledger's coefficient
`6 + 13·k_M + 3·6`) followed by the first-visit cut at the fresh absorbing exit. -/
theorem callTM_run (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesInTime arg cap T) :
    ∃ t ≤ (24 + 13 * M.k) * (T + arg.length + cap.length + 1),
      0 < t ∧
      (∀ j < t, ((callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M emit) (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) j).state
          ≠ some (callExit M emit)) ∧
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M emit) (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) t =
        { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callExit M emit)
            (stateWord (callTM M emit).k (if emit then arg else cap))
          with output := if emit then cap else [] } := by
  sorry

/-- **Row** `Turing.FinTM.exists_loopCfgTM`, statement unchanged. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_exists_loopCfgTM : type_of% @Turing.FinTM.exists_loopCfgTM := by

/-- **Row** `Turing.FinTM.exists_loopTM`, statement unchanged. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_exists_loopTM : type_of% @Turing.FinTM.exists_loopTM := by
  intro body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF s0 R T hF hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround
  exact ⟨loopHostTM body F anchor false, 10, loopHostTM_decides body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF
    s0 R T hF hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround⟩

/-- **Row** `Turing.FinTM.exists_loopFindTM`, statement unchanged. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_exists_loopFindTM : type_of% @Turing.FinTM.exists_loopFindTM := by
  intro body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF out s0 R T hF hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround
  exact ⟨loopHostTM body F anchor true, 10, loopHostTM_finds body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF

/-- **Row** `Turing.FinTM.exists_emitLoopTM`, statement unchanged. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_exists_emitLoopTM : type_of% @Turing.FinTM.exists_emitLoopTM := by
  intro body F anchor Inv stepF emitF s0 R T hF hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround
  exact ⟨emitLoopTM body F anchor, 10, emitLoopTM_computes body F anchor Inv stepF emitF s0 R T

/-- **Row** `Turing.FinTM.exists_installCallTM`, statement unchanged. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_exists_installCallTM : type_of% @Turing.FinTM.exists_installCallTM :=
  fun M f T hM => ⟨callTM M false, callEntry M false, callExit M false, 24 + 13 * M.k,
    callTM_k_pos M false, fun x arg => by

theorem MIG1Gate.row_exists_emitCallTM : type_of% @Turing.FinTM.exists_emitCallTM :=
  fun M f T hM => ⟨callTM M true, callEntry M true, callExit M true, 24 + 13 * M.k,
