-- @shim begin (verbatim from `Build/Primitives.lean`; dropped on landing)
private inductive CatalogPolyControl (c C : ℕ) where
  | copy | setup
  | loop (i : Fin (c + 1))
  | rewind (i : Fin (c + 1))
  | advance (i : Fin (c + 2))
  | emit (j : Fin (C + 1))

private instance catalogPolyControlFintype (c C : ℕ) : Fintype (CatalogPolyControl c C) :=
  derive_fintype% _

private instance catalogPolyControlDecidableEq (c C : ℕ) : DecidableEq (CatalogPolyControl c C) :=
  (proxy_equiv% (CatalogPolyControl c C)).symm.decidableEq

private def catalogPolyMove {c C : ℕ} (i : Fin (c + 1)) (d : SignType)
    (s : CatalogPolyControl c C) : Action (c + 1) Bool (CatalogPolyControl c C) :=
  ⟨0, fun j => (none, if j = i then d else 0), none, some s⟩

private def catalogPolyUnaryTM (c C : ℕ) : FinTM Bool where
  k := c + 1
  State := CatalogPolyControl c C
  tm := {
    q₀ := .copy
    tr := fun s inp w => match s with
      | .copy => match inp with
        | some _ => ⟨.pos, fun _ => (some (some true), .pos), none, some .copy⟩
        | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (some (some true), .neg), none, some .setup⟩
      | .setup =>
        if w 0 = none then
          ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .pos), none, some (.loop (Fin.last c))⟩
        else ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .neg), none, some .setup⟩
      | .loop i =>
        if w i = none then catalogPolyMove i .neg (.rewind i)
        else ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none,
          some (if h : i.val = 0 then .emit ⟨C, Nat.lt_succ_self C⟩
            else .loop ⟨i.val - 1, by omega⟩)⟩
      | .rewind i =>
        if w i = none then catalogPolyMove i .pos (.advance ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩)
        else catalogPolyMove i .neg (.rewind i)
      | .advance i =>
        if h : i.val < c + 1 then catalogPolyMove ⟨i.val, h⟩ .pos (.loop ⟨i.val, h⟩)
        else ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, none⟩
      | .emit j =>
        if h : j.val = 0 then ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some (.advance 0)⟩
        else ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), some true,
          some (.emit ⟨j.val - 1, by omega⟩)⟩ }

private def lenAction (M : FinTM Bool) (m d : SignType) (b : Option Bool)
    (q : Option (M.State ⊕ (Fin 4 ⊕ Option Bool))) :
    Action (M.k + 1) Bool (M.State ⊕ (Fin 4 ⊕ Option Bool)) :=
  ⟨m, fun i => (none, if i.val < M.k then 0 else d), b, q⟩

private def pairCountTM (M : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := M.k + 1
  State := M.State ⊕ (Fin 4 ⊕ Option Bool)
  tm := {
    q₀ := .inl M.tm.q₀
    tr := fun q inp work => match q with
      | .inl s => captureAction Sum.inl (.inr (.inl 0))
          (M.tm.tr s inp fun i => work i.castSucc)
      | .inr (.inl q) => match q.val with
        | 0 => lenAction M 0 .neg none (some (.inr (.inl 1)))
        | 1 => controlAction .neg (some (.inr (.inl 2)))
        | 2 => match inp with
          | some _ => controlAction .neg (some (.inr (.inl 2)))
          | none => controlAction .pos (some (.inr (.inr none)))
        | _ => match inp with
          | none => lenAction M 0 0 (some true) none
          | some _ => match work (Fin.last M.k) with
            | none => lenAction M 0 0 (some false) none
            | some _ => lenAction M .pos .neg none (some (.inr (.inl 3)))
      | .inr (.inr none) => match inp with
        | none => lenAction M 0 0 (some false) none
        | some b => lenAction M .pos 0 none (some (.inr (.inr (some b))))
      | .inr (.inr (some b)) => match inp with
        | none => lenAction M 0 0 (some false) none
        | some d => if b = d then lenAction M .pos 0 none (some (.inr (.inr none)))
          else if b then lenAction M 0 0 (some false) none
          else lenAction M .pos 0 none (some (.inr (.inl 3))) }

private def rawStripTM : FinTM Bool where
  k := 1
  State := Fin 4
  tm := {
    q₀ := 0
    tr := fun q inp work => match q.val with
      | 0 => match inp with
        | some b => ⟨.pos, fun _ => (some (some b), .pos), none, some 0⟩
        | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .neg), none, some 1⟩
      | 1 => match work 0 with
        | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, none⟩
        | some b => ⟨0, fun _ => (some none, .neg), none, some (if b then 2 else 1)⟩
      | 2 => match work 0 with
        | some _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .neg), none, some 2⟩
        | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .pos), none, some 3⟩
      | _ => match work 0 with
        | some b => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .pos), some b, some 3⟩
        | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, none⟩ }

private def anyTrueTM : FinTM Bool where
  k := 0
  State := Unit
  tm := {
    q₀ := ()
    tr := fun _ inp _ => match inp with
      | some false => ⟨.pos, fun i => i.elim0, none, some ()⟩
      | some true => ⟨0, fun i => i.elim0, some true, none⟩
      | none => ⟨0, fun i => i.elim0, some false, none⟩ }

private def splitRestoreTM (k : ℕ) : FinTM Bool where
  k := k + 1
  State := Fin 5 × Bool
  tm := {
    q₀ := (0, false)
    tr := fun q inp work => match q.1.val with
      | 0 => match work 0 with
        | some _ => ⟨.pos, Fin.cases (none, .pos) (fun _ => (some none, .pos)),
            none, some (0, q.2 || inp.isNone)⟩
        | none => ⟨0, Fin.cases (if q.2 then (none, .neg) else (some (some true), .neg))
            (fun _ => (some none, .neg)), none, some (1, false)⟩
      | 1 => match work 0 with
        | some _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .neg), none, some (1, false)⟩
        | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .pos), none, some (2, false)⟩
      | 2 => controlAction .neg (some (3, false))
      | 3 => match inp with
        | some _ => controlAction .neg (some (3, false))
        | none => controlAction .pos (some (4, false))
      | _ => controlAction 0 (some (4, false)) }

private def splitCountAction {k : ℕ} {S H : Type} (emb : S → Bool → H) (ret : Bool → H)
    (over : Bool) (inp : Option Bool) (a : Action k Bool S) : Action (k + 1) Bool H :=
  let over' := over || (a.output.isSome && inp.isNone)
  ⟨if a.output.isSome then .pos else 0, Fin.cases (none, 0) a.workTapes, none,
    some (match a.state with | some q => emb q over' | none => ret over')⟩

private def splitPrepareTM (k : ℕ) : FinTM Bool where
  k := k + 1
  State := Fin 3 × Bool
  tm := {
    q₀ := (0, false)
    tr := fun q inp work => match q.1.val with
      | 0 => match work 0 with
        | some _ => ⟨.pos, Fin.cases (none, .pos) (fun _ => (some (some true), .pos)),
            none, some (0, q.2 || inp.isNone)⟩
        | none => ⟨0, Fin.cases (none, .neg) (fun _ => (some (some true), .neg)),
            none, some (1, q.2)⟩
      | 1 => match work 0 with
        | some _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .neg), none, some (1, q.2)⟩
        | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .pos), none, some (2, q.2)⟩
      | _ => controlAction 0 (some (2, q.2)) }

private def splitRewindTM (k : ℕ) : FinTM Bool where
  k := k + 1
  State := Fin 3
  tm := {
    q₀ := 0
    tr := fun q inp _ => match q.val with
      | 0 => controlAction .neg (some 1)
      | 1 => match inp with
        | some _ => controlAction .neg (some 1)
        | none => controlAction .pos (some 2)
      | _ => controlAction 0 (some 2) }

private def splitEmitTM (k : ℕ) : FinTM Bool where
  k := k + 1
  State := Fin 4
  tm := {
    q₀ := 0
    tr := fun q inp work => match q.val with
      | 0 => match work 0 with
        | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), some false, some 2⟩
        | some _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), inp, some 1⟩
      | 1 => ⟨.pos, Fin.cases (none, .pos) (fun _ => (none, 0)), inp, some 0⟩
      | 2 => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), some true, some 3⟩
      | _ => match inp with
        | some b => ⟨.pos, fun _ => (none, 0), some b, some 3⟩
        | none => controlAction 0 none }

private inductive SplitBodyState (S : Type) where
  | anchor
  | prepare (q : Fin 3 × Bool)
  | count (q : S) (over : Bool)
  | check (over : Bool)
  | rewind (accept : Bool) (q : Fin 3)
  | restore (q : Fin 5 × Bool)
  | emit (q : Fin 4)

private instance splitBodyStateFintype (S : Type) [Fintype S] :
    Fintype (SplitBodyState S) := derive_fintype% _

private instance splitBodyStateDecidableEq (S : Type) [DecidableEq S] :
    DecidableEq (SplitBodyState S) := by
  intro a b
  cases a <;> cases b
  all_goals try (solve | apply isFalse; intro h; cases h)
  · exact isTrue rfl
  · exact decidable_of_iff _ (Iff.symm (iff_of_eq (SplitBodyState.prepare.injEq _ _)))
  · exact decidable_of_iff _ (Iff.symm (iff_of_eq (SplitBodyState.count.injEq _ _ _ _)))
  · exact decidable_of_iff _ (Iff.symm (iff_of_eq (SplitBodyState.check.injEq _ _)))
  · exact decidable_of_iff _ (Iff.symm (iff_of_eq (SplitBodyState.rewind.injEq _ _ _ _)))
  · exact decidable_of_iff _ (Iff.symm (iff_of_eq (SplitBodyState.restore.injEq _ _)))
  · exact decidable_of_iff _ (Iff.symm (iff_of_eq (SplitBodyState.emit.injEq _ _)))

private def splitBodyTM (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) : FinTM Bool where
  k := M.k + 1
  State := SplitBodyState M.State
  tm := {
    q₀ := .anchor
    tr := fun q inp work => match q with
      | .anchor => controlAction 0 (some (.prepare (0, false)))
      | .prepare p =>
        if p.1 = 2 then controlAction 0 (some (.count start p.2))
        else ((splitPrepareTM M.k).tm.tr p inp work).mapState .prepare
      | .count q over => splitCountAction .count .check over inp
          (M.tm.tr q none (fun i => work i.succ))
      | .check over => controlAction 0 (some (.rewind (!over && inp.isNone) 0))
      | .rewind ok p =>
        if p = 2 then controlAction 0 (some (if ok then .emit 0 else .restore (0, false)))
        else ((splitRewindTM M.k).tm.tr p inp work).mapState (.rewind ok)
      | .restore p =>
        if p = (4, false) then controlAction 0 (some .anchor)
        else ((splitRestoreTM M.k).tm.tr p inp work).mapState .restore
      | .emit p => ((splitEmitTM M.k).tm.tr p inp work).mapState .emit }

private def emitterCompareTM : FinTM Bool where
  k := 2
  State := Fin 3 × Bool
  tm := {
    q₀ := (0, true)
    tr := fun q _ work => match q.1.val with
      | 0 =>
        if work 0 = none ∧ work 1 = none then
          ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .neg), none, some (1, q.2)⟩
        else
          ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .pos), none,
            some (0, q.2 && decide (work 0 = work 1))⟩
      | 1 =>
        if work 0 = none ∧ work 1 = none then
          ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .pos), none, some (2, q.2)⟩
        else ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .neg), none, some (1, q.2)⟩
      | _ => controlAction 0 (some (2, q.2)) }

private def emitterP2EraseTM : FinTM Bool where
  k := 1
  State := Fin 3
  tm := {
    q₀ := 0
    tr := fun q _ work => match q.val with
      | 0 => match work 0 with
        | some _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .pos), none, some 0⟩
        | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .neg), none, some 1⟩
      | 1 => match work 0 with
        | some _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (some none, .neg), none, some 1⟩
        | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .pos), none, some 2⟩
      | _ => controlAction 0 (some 2) }

private def emitterP2PrepareTM : FinTM Bool where
  k := 3
  State := Fin 9 × Bool
  tm := {
    q₀ := (0, false)
    tr := fun q inp work => match q.1.val with
      | 0 => match work 0 with
        | some b => ⟨.pos, fun i =>
            (if i = 1 then some (some b) else none, if i = 2 then 0 else .pos),
            none, some (0, q.2 || inp.isNone)⟩
        | none => controlAction 0 (some (1, q.2))
      | 1 => match inp with
        | some b => ⟨.pos, fun i =>
            (if i = 2 then some (some b) else none, if i = 2 then .pos else 0),
            none, some (1, q.2)⟩
        | none => controlAction 0 (some (2, q.2))
      | 2 => ⟨0, fun i => (none, if i = 2 then 0 else .neg), none, some (3, q.2)⟩
      | 3 => match work 0 with
        | some _ => ⟨0, fun i => (none, if i = 2 then 0 else .neg), none, some (3, q.2)⟩
        | none => ⟨0, fun i => (none, if i = 2 then 0 else .pos), none, some (4, q.2)⟩
      | 4 => ⟨0, fun i => (none, if i = 2 then .neg else 0), none, some (5, q.2)⟩
      | 5 => match work 2 with
        | some _ => ⟨0, fun i => (none, if i = 2 then .neg else 0), none, some (5, q.2)⟩
        | none => ⟨0, fun i => (none, if i = 2 then .pos else 0), none, some (6, q.2)⟩
      | 6 => controlAction .neg (some (7, q.2))
      | 7 => match inp with
        | some _ => controlAction .neg (some (7, q.2))
        | none => controlAction .pos (some (8, q.2))
      | _ => controlAction 0 (some (8, q.2)) }

private def emitterP2LeftIndex (k l : ℕ) : Fin k ↪ Fin (k + l + 1) :=
  (Fin.castAddEmb l).trans (Fin.succEmb (k + l))

private def emitterP2RightIndex (k l : ℕ) : Fin l ↪ Fin (k + l + 1) :=
  (Fin.natAddEmb k).trans (Fin.succEmb (k + l))

private def emitterP2OneIndex {l : ℕ} (slot : Fin l) : Fin 1 ↪ Fin l where
  toFun _ := slot
  inj' := fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _

private def emitterP2SmallIndex (k l : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hl : 0 < l) :
    Fin 3 ↪ Fin (k + l + 1) where
  toFun i := if i = 0 then 0 else if i = 1 then emitterP2LeftIndex k l ⟨0, hk⟩
    else emitterP2RightIndex k l ⟨0, hl⟩
  inj' := by
    intro a b h
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> try rfl
    all_goals have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    all_goals simp [emitterP2LeftIndex, emitterP2RightIndex] at hv <;> omega

private def emitterP2PairIndex (k l : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hl : 0 < l) :
    Fin 2 ↪ Fin (k + l + 1) where
  toFun i := if i = 0 then emitterP2LeftIndex k l ⟨0, hk⟩
    else emitterP2RightIndex k l ⟨0, hl⟩
  inj' := by
    intro a b h
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> try rfl
    all_goals have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    all_goals simp [emitterP2LeftIndex, emitterP2RightIndex] at hv <;> omega

private inductive EmitterP2State (S T : Type) where
  | anchor
  | prepare (q : Fin 9 × Bool)
  | widthStart
  | width (q : S)
  | lengthStart
  | length (q : T)
  | compare (q : Fin 3 × Bool)
  | eraseLeft (ok : Bool) (q : Fin 3)
  | eraseRight (ok : Bool) (q : Fin 3)
  | advance (q : Fin 5 × Bool)
  | emit (q : Fin 4)

private instance emitterP2StateFintype (S T : Type) [Fintype S] [Fintype T] :
    Fintype (EmitterP2State S T) := derive_fintype% _

private instance emitterP2StateDecidableEq (S T : Type) [DecidableEq S] [DecidableEq T] :
    DecidableEq (EmitterP2State S T) := by
  intro a b
  cases a <;> cases b
  all_goals try (solve | apply isFalse; intro h; cases h)
  · exact isTrue rfl
  · exact decidable_of_iff _ (Iff.symm (iff_of_eq (EmitterP2State.prepare.injEq _ _)))
  · exact isTrue rfl
  · exact decidable_of_iff _ (Iff.symm (iff_of_eq (EmitterP2State.width.injEq _ _)))
  · exact isTrue rfl
  · exact decidable_of_iff _ (Iff.symm (iff_of_eq (EmitterP2State.length.injEq _ _)))
  · exact decidable_of_iff _ (Iff.symm (iff_of_eq (EmitterP2State.compare.injEq _ _)))
  · exact decidable_of_iff _ (Iff.symm (iff_of_eq (EmitterP2State.eraseLeft.injEq _ _ _ _)))
  · exact decidable_of_iff _ (Iff.symm (iff_of_eq (EmitterP2State.eraseRight.injEq _ _ _ _)))
  · exact decidable_of_iff _ (Iff.symm (iff_of_eq (EmitterP2State.advance.injEq _ _)))
  · exact decidable_of_iff _ (Iff.symm (iff_of_eq (EmitterP2State.emit.injEq _ _)))

private def emitterP2BodyTM (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) : FinTM Bool where
  k := C.k + D.k + 1
  State := EmitterP2State C.State D.State
  tm := {
    q₀ := .anchor
    tr := fun q inp work => match q with
      | .anchor => controlAction 0 (some (.prepare (0, false)))
      | .prepare p =>
        if p.1 = 8 then controlAction 0 (some (if p.2 then .eraseLeft false 0 else .widthStart))
        else ((embedEmitTM (emitterP2SmallIndex C.k D.k hk hl)
            emitterP2PrepareTM.tm).tr p inp work).mapState .prepare
      | .widthStart => ((embedEmitTM (emitterP2LeftIndex C.k D.k)
          C.tm).tr ce inp work).mapState .width
      | .width p =>
        if p = cx then controlAction 0 (some .lengthStart)
        else ((embedEmitTM (emitterP2LeftIndex C.k D.k) C.tm).tr p inp work).mapState .width
      | .lengthStart => ((embedEmitTM (emitterP2RightIndex C.k D.k)
          D.tm).tr de inp work).mapState .length
      | .length p =>
        if p = dx then controlAction 0 (some (.compare (0, true)))
        else ((embedEmitTM (emitterP2RightIndex C.k D.k) D.tm).tr p inp work).mapState .length
      | .compare p =>
        if p.1 = 2 then controlAction 0 (some (.eraseLeft p.2 0))
        else ((embedEmitTM (emitterP2PairIndex C.k D.k hk hl)
            emitterCompareTM.tm).tr p inp work).mapState .compare
      | .eraseLeft ok p =>
        if p = 2 then controlAction 0 (some (.eraseRight ok 0))
        else ((embedEmitTM (emitterP2OneIndex (emitterP2LeftIndex C.k D.k ⟨0, hk⟩))
          emitterP2EraseTM.tm).tr p inp work).mapState (.eraseLeft ok)
      | .eraseRight ok p =>
        if p = 2 then controlAction 0 (some (if ok then .emit 0 else .advance (0, false)))
        else ((embedEmitTM (emitterP2OneIndex (emitterP2RightIndex C.k D.k ⟨0, hl⟩))
          emitterP2EraseTM.tm).tr p inp work).mapState (.eraseRight ok)
      | .advance p =>
        if p = (4, false) then controlAction 0 (some .anchor)
        else ((embedEmitTM (emitterP2OneIndex (0 : Fin (C.k + D.k + 1)))
          (splitRestoreTM 0).tm).tr p inp work).mapState .advance
      | .emit p => ((embedEmitTM (emitterP2OneIndex (0 : Fin (C.k + D.k + 1)))
          (splitEmitTM 0).tm).tr p inp work).mapState .emit }
-- @shim end

/-! #### Prepending, incrementing, validating and extracting -/

/-- **The prepending machine** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.prependTM`, made public in place at
`Build/Primitives.lean:129` by the rename `catalogPrefixTM → prependTM`, body unchanged). A
machine with no work tapes that writes the fixed word `w` and then copies its input, so that it
computes `x ↦ w ++ x`; its last state is the copy state. [AB09, §1.2] -/
def prependTM (w : List Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := 0
  State := Fin (w.length + 1)
  tm :=
    { q₀ := 0
      tr := fun q inp _ =>
        if h : q.val < w.length then
          ⟨0, fun i => i.elim0, some w[q.val], some ⟨q.val + 1, by omega⟩⟩
        else match inp with
          | some b => ⟨1, fun i => i.elim0, some b, some q⟩
          | none => ⟨0, fun i => i.elim0, none, none⟩ }

/-- **The prepending machine's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.prependTM_computes`, today's
private `catalogPrefixTM_computes` (`Primitives.lean:198`) made public in place, statement
verbatim modulo the rename, proof unchanged). The prepending machine computes `x ↦ w ++ x`
within `|w| + n + 1` steps.

**Proof sketch.** Today's proof: the emission chain writes `w` in `|w|` steps
(`catalogPrefixTM_emit`), the copy state copies the input in `|x|` more (`catalogPrefixTM_copy`),
and the blank after the input halts. -/
theorem prependTM_computes (w : List Bool) :
    (prependTM w).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => w ++ x) (fun n => w.length + n + 1) := by
  sorry

/-- **The fixed-width incrementer** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.incFixedTM`, made public in place at
`Primitives.lean:460`, body unchanged). A machine with no work tapes that first scans its input
for a `false` without emitting (an all-`true` word is the overflow, which halts with empty
output), rewinds, and then emits the little-endian fixed-width successor `Turing.incFixed x`:
`false` over the carry prefix, `true` at the first `false`, then the rest verbatim. -/

  State := Fin 4

    { q₀ := 0
      tr := fun q inp _ => match q.val with
        | 0 => match inp with
          | some true => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, none, some 0⟩
          | some false => controlAction .neg (some 1)
          | none => controlAction 0 none
        | 1 => match inp with
          | some _ => controlAction .neg (some 1)
          | none => controlAction .pos (some 2)
        | 2 => match inp with
          | some true => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some false, some 2⟩
          | some false => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some true, some 3⟩
          | none => controlAction 0 none
        | _ => match inp with
          | some b => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some b, some 3⟩
          | none => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, none, none⟩ }

/-- **The incrementer's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.incFixedTM_computes`, today's private
`incFixed_computes` (`Primitives.lean:487`) made public in place, statement verbatim modulo the
rename, proof unchanged). On every input the incrementer halts within `3·(|x| + 1)` steps with
output `(incFixed x).getD []`.

**Proof sketch.** Today's proof: the overflow scan, the rewind and the emitting pass each cost
at most `|x| + 1` steps, by the case split `incFixed_cases`. -/
theorem incFixedTM_computes (x : List Bool) :
    incFixedTM.ComputesInTime x ((incFixed x).getD []) (3 * (x.length + 1)) := by
  sorry

/-- **The pair-grammar validator** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.pairValidTM`, made public in place at
`Primitives.lean:569`, body unchanged). A machine with no work tapes that scans aligned pairs of
input bits, remembering the first bit of the current pair, and emits the single verdict
`(pairDecode x).isSome` at the separator `false, true` or at the first malformed pair. -/

  k := 0
  State := Option Bool
  tm :=
    { q₀ := none
      tr := fun q inp _ => match q, inp with
        | none, some b => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, none, some (some b)⟩
        | some b, some c =>
          if b = c then ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, none, some none⟩
          else ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some (!b && c), none⟩
        | _, none => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, some false, none⟩ }

/-- **The validator's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.pairValidTM_computes`, today's private
`pairValid_computes` (`Primitives.lean:651`) made public in place, statement verbatim, proof
unchanged). On every input the validator halts within `|x| + 1` steps with output
`[(pairDecode x).isSome]`.

**Proof sketch.** Today's proof: one step per input symbol (`pairValid_run`), and the verdict
is emitted on the halting transition. -/
theorem pairValidTM_computes (x : List Bool) :
    pairValidTM.ComputesInTime x [(pairDecode x).isSome] (x.length + 1) := by
  sorry

/-- **The pair extractor** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.pairExtractTM`, made public in place at
`Primitives.lean:665`, body unchanged). On `pairEncode a b` it validates the doubled prefix while
buffering `a` on its single work tape, then emits `a` if `first` and the suffix `b` if
`second`; on a malformed input it halts with empty output. One machine serves the
first-component, second-component and concatenation rows. -/
def pairExtractTM (first second : Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := 1
  State := Option Bool ⊕ Fin 3
  tm :=
    { q₀ := .inl none
      tr := fun q inp work => match q with
        | .inl none => match inp with
          | some b => ⟨.pos, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some (.inl (some b))⟩
          | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, none⟩
        | .inl (some b) => match inp with
          | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, none⟩
          | some c =>
            if b = c then
              ⟨.pos, fun _ => (some (some b), .pos), none, some (.inl none)⟩
            else if b then ⟨.pos, fun _ => (none, 0), none, none⟩
            else ⟨.pos, fun _ => (none, .neg), none, some (.inr 0)⟩
        | .inr q => match q.val with
          | 0 => match work 0 with
            | some _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .neg), none, some (.inr 0)⟩
            | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .pos), none, some (.inr 1)⟩
          | 1 => match work 0 with
            | some b => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .pos), if first then some b else none, some (.inr 1)⟩
            | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some (.inr 2)⟩
          | _ => if second then match inp with
              | some b => ⟨.pos, fun _ => (none, 0), some b, some (.inr 2)⟩
              | none => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, none⟩
            else ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, none⟩ }

/-- **The extractor's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.pairExtractTM_computes`, today's private
`pairExtract_computes` (`Primitives.lean:960`) made public in place, statement verbatim modulo
the rename, proof unchanged). On every input the extractor halts within `5·(|x| + 1)` steps;
its output is the selected components of the decoded pair, and empty when the input is not a
pair encoding.

**Proof sketch.** Today's proof: the aligned scan reads the doubled prefix two cells at a time
while buffering, the separator turns it into a rewind of the buffer, the replay emits `a`, and
the suffix copy emits `b`; each phase is linear in `|x|` (`extract_run`). -/
theorem pairExtractTM_computes (first second : Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    (pairExtractTM first second).ComputesInTime x
      (match pairDecode x with
        | some (a, b) => (if first then a else []) ++ (if second then b else [])
        | none => []) (5 * (x.length + 1)) := by
  sorry

/-- **First component** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.pairExtractTM_fst`, new in `Primitives`; proved).
The extractor at `(true, false)` computes the first component of a decoded pair, and `[]` on a
malformed input, within `5·(n + 1)` steps.

**Proof sketch.** Specialize `pairExtractTM_computes` and split on the decoding. -/
theorem pairExtractTM_fst :
    (pairExtractTM true false).ComputesFunInTime

/-! #### Polynomial evaluation -/

/-- **The unary polynomial generator** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.polyUnaryTM`, new in `Primitives`
after the private engine `catalogPolyUnaryTM`; the body is the case split of today's
`computesFunInTime_polyUnary`, `Primitives.lean:2133`). The machine that writes
`C·(|x| + 1)^e` ones: for `e = 0` the constant machine of `List.replicate C true`, and for
`e = d + 1` the private engine with `d + 1` nested unary loop tapes of side `|x| + 1`, installed
by one input scan, which emits `C` ones at each point of the box. -/
def polyUnaryTM (C : ℕ) : ℕ → FinTM Bool
  | 0 => constTM (List.replicate C true)
  | d + 1 => catalogPolyUnaryTM d C

/-- **The unary generator's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.polyUnaryTM_computes`, new in
`Primitives` before `computesFunInTime_polyUnary`). The generator writes `C·(|x| + 1)^e` ones
within `(C + 5e + 4)·(n + 1)^e` steps: the sharp degree `e`, not the row's `e + 1`.

**Proof sketch.** For `e = 0`, `constTM_computes` gives `C + 1 ≤ C + 4` steps. For `e = d + 1`,
today's private `catalogPoly_unary_computes d C` (`Primitives.lean:1371`) is exactly the bound
`(C + 5(d + 1) + 4)·(n + 1)^(d + 1)`. This replaces Catalog's `f2_unary_sharp`, whose
`e = 0` case went through a linear allowance only because it reused the constant row's
existential constant. -/
theorem polyUnaryTM_computes (C e : ℕ) :
    (polyUnaryTM C e).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ e) true)
      (fun n => (C + 5 * e + 4) * (n + 1) ^ e) := by
  sorry

/-- **The unary generator's space** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.polyUnaryTM_spaceUsed`, new in
`Primitives` after `polyUnaryTM_computes`; for `e = d + 1` it is Catalog's private
`f2_poly_space`, which moves with `f2_polyHeads`, `f2_polyHeads_bounds` and `f2_poly_step`). At
every time the generator has visited at most `5e·(|x| + 1)` work cells.

**Proof sketch.** For `e = 0` there are no work tapes. For `e = d + 1`, `f2_poly_space`: the
startup lasts `2(|x| + 1)` steps from the origin, and the loop invariant confines every later
head to `[-1, |x| + 1]`, including after the halt; contain the visited images in the larger
interval and sum over the `d + 1` tapes. The number of loop iterations never appears. -/
theorem polyUnaryTM_spaceUsed (C e : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (polyUnaryTM C e).tm.spaceUsed ((polyUnaryTM C e).tm.initCfg x) t ≤
      5 * e * (x.length + 1) := by
  sorry

/-- **The binary polynomial evaluator** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.polyBitsTM`, new in `Primitives`
after `polyUnaryTM`; the body is the case split of today's
`computesFunInTime_polyBits_spaceUsed`, `Build/Catalog.lean:4377`). The machine computing
`x ↦ Nat.bits (C·(|x| + 1)^e)`: the constant machine of the answer when `C = 0` or `e = 0`, and
otherwise the unary generator buffered into the binary length counter. The split avoids the
generator's linear banks where the answer is a constant (round-1 finding 5 of the space rows). -/
def polyBitsTM (C e : ℕ) : FinTM Bool :=
  if C = 0 then constTM (Nat.bits 0) else
    match e with
    | 0 => constTM (Nat.bits C)
    | d + 1 => bufferedCompTM (polyUnaryTM C (d + 1)) lengthBitsTM

/-- **The binary evaluator's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.polyBitsTM_computes`, new in
`Primitives` before `computesFunInTime_polyBits`; proved, from the gated specs). The evaluator
computes `x ↦ Nat.bits (C·(|x| + 1)^e)` within `(7C + 5e + 11)·(n + 1)^e` steps.

**Proof sketch.** If `C = 0` or `e = 0`, the constant machine of the answer takes
`|Nat.bits C| + 1 ≤ C + 1` steps (`Turing.length_bits_le_self`). Otherwise the buffered
composition takes the generator's `(C + 5e + 4)·P` steps, `P = (n + 1)^e`, plus the
intermediate's length `C·P` and `2`, plus the counter's `5·(C·P + 1)`, in all
`(7C + 5e + 4)·P + 7 ≤ (7C + 5e + 11)·P` (`bufferedCompTM_computesInTime`). -/
theorem polyBitsTM_computes (C e : ℕ) :
    (polyBitsTM C e).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (C * (x.length + 1) ^ e))
      (fun n => (7 * C + 5 * e + 11) * (n + 1) ^ e) := by
  intro x
  have hp : 1 ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ e := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (Nat.succ_pos _)
  by_cases hC : C = 0
  · subst hC
    simp only [polyBitsTM, if_true, Nat.zero_mul]
    refine (constTM_computes (Nat.bits 0) x).mono ?_
    rw [Nat.zero_bits, List.length_nil]
    exact Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hp
  · cases e with
    | zero =>
      simp only [polyBitsTM, hC, if_false, pow_zero, Nat.mul_one]
      refine (constTM_computes (Nat.bits C) x).mono ?_
      have := Turing.length_bits_le_self C
      omega
    | succ d =>
      simp only [polyBitsTM, hC, if_false]
      have h := bufferedCompTM_computesInTime (polyUnaryTM C (d + 1)) lengthBitsTM
        (polyUnaryTM_computes C (d + 1) x)
        (lengthBitsTM_computes (List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ (d + 1)) true))
      simp only [List.length_replicate] at h
      refine h.mono ?_
      dsimp only
      generalize (x.length + 1) ^ (d + 1) = P at hp ⊢
      calc (C + 5 * (d + 1) + 4) * P + C * P + 2 + 5 * (C * P + 1)
          = (7 * C + 5 * (d + 1) + 4) * P + 7 := by ring
        _ ≤ (7 * C + 5 * (d + 1) + 4) * P + 7 * P := by omega
        _ = (7 * C + 5 * (d + 1) + 11) * P := by ring

        | none => false])
      (fun n => (C + 5 * e + 17) * ((n + 1) ^ e + n + 1)) := by
  sorry

/-- **The marker strip** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.stripLastTM`, new in `Primitives` after the
private `anyTrueTM`; the body is the witness of today's `computesFunInTime_stripLast`,
`Primitives.lean:2812`, with its composites named). The timed conditional whose decider tests

/-- **The marker strip's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.stripLastTM_computes`, new in
`Primitives` before `computesFunInTime_stripLast`). On `pairEncode a v` the strip outputs
`pairEncode a u` where `u` is `v` cut at its last `true` (`Turing.splitAtLastTrue`), and `[]`

`catalogMarker_cases` with `Turing.eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode`. -/
theorem stripLastTM_computes :

        | some (a, v) =>

          | some u => pairEncode a u

        | none => [])

/-! #### The threaded map -/

-- @shim begin (verbatim, modulo the rename `a2_ → fwd`, from `Build/Catalog.lean:5100-5158`;
-- these definitions and the 26 lemmas of their family move to `Primitives` at the fill stage)
private inductive FwdMapState (Q : Type) where
  | parse (pending : Option Bool)
  | copyB | backB | backA | emitA | emitAgain (b : Bool) | separator
  | run (q : Q) (tag : Bool)
  deriving DecidableEq

private instance fwdMapStateFintype (Q : Type) [Fintype Q] : Fintype (FwdMapState Q) :=
  derive_fintype% _

private def fwdMapAct (M : FinTM Bool) (inp : SignType)
    (a b : Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (out : Option Bool)
    (next : Option (FwdMapState M.State)) : Action (1 + (1 + M.k)) Bool (FwdMapState M.State) :=
  ⟨inp, tapeBlocks (fun _ => a) b (fun _ => (none, 0)), out, next⟩

private def fwdMapTM (M : FinTM Bool) (forward : Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := 1 + (1 + M.k)
  State := FwdMapState M.State
  tm := {
    q₀ := .parse none
    tr := fun q inp work =>
      let act := fwdMapAct M
      let first := work (Fin.castAdd (1 + M.k) (0 : Fin 1))
      let second := work (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd M.k (0 : Fin 1)))
      match q with
      | .parse none => match inp with
        | none => act 0 (none, 0) (none, 0) none none
        | some b => act .pos (none, 0) (none, 0) none (some (.parse (some b)))
      | .parse (some b) => match inp with
        | none => act 0 (none, 0) (none, 0) none none
        | some d => if b = d then
            act .pos (some (some b), .pos) (none, 0) none (some (.parse none))
          else if b then act .pos (none, 0) (none, 0) none none
          else act .pos (none, .neg) (none, 0) none (some .copyB)
      | .copyB => match inp with
        | some b => act .pos (none, 0) (some (some b), .pos) none (some .copyB)
        | none => act 0 (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some .backB)
      | .backB => match second with
        | some _ => act 0 (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some .backB)
        | none => act 0 (none, 0) (none, .pos) none (some .backA)
      | .backA => match first with
        | some _ => act 0 (none, .neg) (none, 0) none (some .backA)
        | none => act 0 (none, .pos) (none, 0) none (some .emitA)
      | .emitA => match first with
        | some b => act 0 (none, 0) (none, 0) (some b) (some (.emitAgain b))
        | none => act 0 (none, 0) (none, 0) (some false) (some .separator)
      | .emitAgain b => act 0 (none, .pos) (none, 0) (some b) (some .emitA)
      | .separator => act 0 (none, 0) (none, 0) (some true) (some (.run M.tm.q₀ true))
      | .run q b => if forward then
          let a := M.tm.tr q second (fun i => work (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 1 i)))
          let m := virtualMove b second a.inputTape
          ⟨0, tapeBlocks (fun _ => (none, 0)) (none, m) a.workTapes,
            a.output, a.state.map (fun q => .run q (virtualNextTag b m))⟩
        else controlAction 0 (some (.run q b)) }
-- @shim end

/-- **The threaded map** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.pairMapSndTM`, new in `Primitives` at the fill
stage, when the forwarding-controller family moves from Catalog; the body is the witness of
today's `computesFunInTime_pairMapSnd_spaceUsed`, `Build/Catalog.lean:5901`). On
`pairEncode a b` it validates the pair while buffering both components on two work tapes,
emits the encoding of `a` followed by the separator, and then runs `Mg` on the buffered `b`
through clamped virtual input, forwarding `Mg`'s emissions, so that it outputs
`pairEncode a (g b)`; a malformed input gives `[]`. It replaces the captured-payload
`pairMapTM` of `Primitives`, whose capture tape cannot carry a linear space bound
(consolidation). -/
def pairMapSndTM (Mg : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool := fwdMapTM Mg true

/-- **The threaded map's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.pairMapSndTM_computes`, new in
`Primitives` before `computesFunInTime_pairMapSnd`). If `Mg` computes `g` within a monotone
`Tg`, the threaded map computes `pairEncode a b ↦ pairEncode a (g b)` (and `[]` off the
encodings) within `22·(n + 1 + Tg n)` steps.

**Proof sketch.** The time half of Catalog's `computesFunInTime_pairMapSnd_spaceUsed`: rejection
and the launch of the payload each take at most `5·(n + 1)` steps (`a2_map_reject`,
`a2_map_launch`, moved); the forwarded payload then runs `Tg |b|` steps in lockstep
(`a2_mapVirtual_run`), and `|b| ≤ n` with monotonicity gives `Tg n`. -/
theorem pairMapSndTM_computes {Mg : FinTM Bool} {g : List Bool → List Bool} {Tg : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hg : Mg.ComputesFunInTime g Tg) (hTg : Monotone Tg) :
    (pairMapSndTM Mg).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun z => match pairDecode z with
        | some (a, b) => pairEncode a (g b)
        | none => [])
      (fun n => 22 * (n + 1 + Tg n)) := by
  sorry

/-- **The threaded map's space** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.pairMapSndTM_spaceUsed`, new in
`Primitives` after `pairMapSndTM_computes`). If `Mg` uses at most `Sg |y|` work cells on every
input `y` at every time, with `Sg` monotone, then the threaded map uses at most

**Proof sketch.** The space half of the same Catalog row (`a2_map_space`, moved): the two

theorem pairMapSndTM_spaceUsed {Mg : FinTM Bool} (Sg : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hgs : ∀ (y : List Bool) (t : ℕ), Mg.tm.spaceUsed (Mg.tm.initCfg y) t ≤ Sg y.length)
    (hSg : Monotone Sg) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :

/-- **The unary token splitter** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.unaryTokenTM`, made public in place at

with no work tapes that, in one left-to-right scan, emits the leading unary token of its input
(the `true`s up to and including the first `false`) doubled, then the pair separator, then the
rest of the input, so that it outputs `pairEncode` of `Turing.unaryTokenSplit x`. -/
def unaryTokenTM : FinTM Bool where
  k := 0
  State := Fin 6
  tm :=

      tr := fun q inp _ => match q.val with

          | none => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, some false, some 4⟩
        | 1 => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some true, some 0⟩
        | 2 => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some false, some 3⟩
        | 3 => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, some false, some 4⟩
        | 4 => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, some true, some 5⟩
        | _ => match inp with
          | some b => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some b, some 5⟩

namespace Turing

/-- **The copy endpoint from a canonical seam** (landing: `Turing.Cfg.ofWords_copy_endpoint`, new
in `Build/Catalog.lean`, Part 1, after `copyTM_run_ofCfg`). If the destination word of the seam
`Cfg.ofWords q w` is empty, then the framed copy endpoint of `Turing.copyTM_run_ofCfg` started
there (state `q'`, the destination interval overwritten with `w src`, every other cell, head and
the output unchanged) is the seam `Cfg.ofWords q' (Function.update w dst (w src))`.

**Proof sketch.** Today's `Cfg.ext` computation in the proof of `Turing.copyTM_run`
(`Build/Catalog.lean:1382`): at the origin heads of `Cfg.ofWords` the destination interval is
`[0, |w src|)`, which `bufferTape (w src)` fills exactly, and outside it the blank destination
word agrees with `bufferTape (w src)`'s blanks; every other tape is untouched. -/
theorem Cfg.ofWords_copy_endpoint {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool} (q q' : S)
    (w : Fin k → List Bool) (src dst : Fin k) (hdst : w dst = []) :
    ({ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w) with
        state := some q'
        workTapes := fun j p =>
          if j = dst ∧ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j ≤ p ∧
              p < (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j + ((w src).length : ℤ)
            then FinTM.bufferTape (w src) (p - (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j)
          else (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapes j p } : Cfg k Bool S x) =
      Cfg.ofWords q' (Function.update w dst (w src)) := by
  apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [Cfg.ofWords]
  funext j q
  by_cases hj : j = dst
  · subst j
    simp only [Function.update_self, hdst, FinTM.bufferTape_nil, true_and]
    split_ifs with hq
    · rfl
    · by_cases h0 : 0 ≤ q
      · simp [FinTM.bufferTape, h0, List.getElem?_eq_none]
        omega
      · simp [FinTM.bufferTape, h0]
  · simp [hj]

/-- **The transfer endpoint from a canonical seam** (landing:
`Turing.Cfg.ofWords_transfer_endpoint`, new in `Build/Catalog.lean`, Part 1, after
`transferTM_run_ofCfg`). If `src ≠ dst` and the destination word of the seam `Cfg.ofWords q w` is
empty, then the framed transfer endpoint of `Turing.transferTM_run_ofCfg` started there (state
`q'`, the source interval blanked, the destination interval overwritten with `w src`, everything
else unchanged) is the seam
`Cfg.ofWords q' (Function.update (Function.update w src []) dst (w src))`.

**Proof sketch.** Today's `Cfg.ext` computation in the proof of `Turing.transferTM_run`
(`Build/Catalog.lean:1297`): as the copy endpoint, with the source interval `[0, |w src|)`
blanked, which together with the blanks of `bufferTape (w src)` outside it is
`bufferTape []`. -/
theorem Cfg.ofWords_transfer_endpoint {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool} (q q' : S)
    (w : Fin k → List Bool) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (hdst : w dst = []) :
    ({ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w) with
        state := some q'
        workTapes := fun j p =>
          if j = src ∧ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j ≤ p ∧
              p < (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j + ((w src).length : ℤ)
            then none
          else if j = dst ∧ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j ≤ p ∧
              p < (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j + ((w src).length : ℤ)
            then FinTM.bufferTape (w src) (p - (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j)
          else (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapes j p } : Cfg k Bool S x) =
      Cfg.ofWords q' (Function.update (Function.update w src []) dst (w src)) := by
  apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [Cfg.ofWords]
  funext j q
  by_cases hs : j = src
  · subst j
    simp only [Function.update_of_ne hne, Function.update_self,
      FinTM.bufferTape_nil, hne, false_and, ite_false, true_and]
    split_ifs with hq
    · rfl
    · by_cases h0 : 0 ≤ q
      · simp [FinTM.bufferTape, h0, List.getElem?_eq_none]
        omega
      · simp [FinTM.bufferTape, h0]
  · by_cases hd : j = dst
    · subst j
      simp only [Function.update_self, hdst, FinTM.bufferTape_nil,
        hs, false_and, ite_false, true_and]
      split_ifs with hq
      · rfl
      · by_cases h0 : 0 ≤ q
        · simp [FinTM.bufferTape, h0, List.getElem?_eq_none]
          omega
        · simp [FinTM.bufferTape, h0]
    · simp [hs, hd]

/-- **Retirement evidence, not landed.** The retired row `Turing.copyTM_run` is a four-line
consequence of `Turing.copyTM_run_ofCfg` and `Cfg.ofWords_copy_endpoint`; each of its two
consumer sites (`Build/CertShell.lean:571`, `TuringMachine/CodeSimulator.lean:1295`) is edited
to this derivation. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.retired_copyTM_run : type_of% @Turing.copyTM_run := by
  intro x k src dst hne w hdst
  have h := copyTM_run_ofCfg src dst hne (w src) (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) .sweep w) rfl
    (by intro p _ _; simp [Cfg.ofWords])
  exact ⟨_, by omega, h.2.1, h.1.trans (Cfg.ofWords_copy_endpoint _ _ w src dst hdst)⟩

/-- **Retirement evidence, not landed.** The retired row `Turing.transferTM_run` is a four-line
consequence of `Turing.transferTM_run_ofCfg` and `Cfg.ofWords_transfer_endpoint`; each of its
three consumer sites (`Build/CertShell.lean:585`, `:589`, `:602`) is edited to this
derivation. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.retired_transferTM_run : type_of% @Turing.transferTM_run := by
  intro x k src dst hne w hdst
  have h := transferTM_run_ofCfg src dst hne (w src) (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) .sweep w) rfl
    (by intro p _ _; simp [Cfg.ofWords])
  exact ⟨_, by omega, h.2.1, h.1.trans (Cfg.ofWords_transfer_endpoint _ _ w src dst hne hdst)⟩

end Turing

/-- **Space row** `Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_polyBits_spaceUsed`, statement unchanged: space
from time, and no work tapes at all when `C = 0`. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_computesFunInTime_polyBits_spaceUsed :
    type_of% @Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_polyBits_spaceUsed := by
  intro C e
  refine ⟨polyBitsTM C e, (polyBitsTM C e).k * (7 * C + 5 * e + 11 + 1) + (7 * C + 5 * e + 11),
    fun x => (polyBitsTM_computes C e x).mono (Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos _) (Nat.le_succ e))), fun x t => ?_⟩
  by_cases hC : C = 0
  · have hk : (polyBitsTM C e).k = 0 := by subst hC; rfl
    rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_zero_tapes_eq_zero _ _ hk]
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  · refine (ComputesInTime.spaceUsed_le (polyBitsTM_computes C e x) t).trans ?_
    dsimp only
    have hP : (x.length + 1) ^ e ≤ C * (x.length + 1) ^ e := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
    generalize (x.length + 1) ^ e = P at hP ⊢
    have h1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (7 * C + 5 * e + 11) hP
    have hb : (7 * C + 5 * e + 11) * P + 1 ≤ (7 * C + 5 * e + 11 + 1) * (C * P + 1) := by
      have h2 : (7 * C + 5 * e + 11 + 1) * (C * P + 1) =
          (7 * C + 5 * e + 11) * (C * P) + (7 * C + 5 * e + 11) + C * P + 1 := by ring
      omega
    calc (polyBitsTM C e).k * ((7 * C + 5 * e + 11) * P + 1)
        ≤ (polyBitsTM C e).k * ((7 * C + 5 * e + 11 + 1) * (C * P + 1)) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hb
      _ = (polyBitsTM C e).k * (7 * C + 5 * e + 11 + 1) * (C * P + 1) := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _)

    rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_zero_tapes_eq_zero _ _ rfl]; omega⟩

/-- **Space row** `Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairLenCheck_spaceUsed`, statement unchanged:
space from the sharp time spec. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_computesFunInTime_pairLenCheck_spaceUsed :
    type_of% @Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairLenCheck_spaceUsed := by
  intro C e
  refine ⟨pairLenCheckTM C e,
    2 * (C + 5 * e + 17) + (pairLenCheckTM C e).k * (C + 5 * e + 17 + 1), fun x => ?_,
    fun x t => ?_⟩
  · have h1 : (x.length + 1) ^ e ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos _) (Nat.le_succ e)
    have h2 : x.length + 1 ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) := Nat.le_self_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero e) _
    refine (pairLenCheckTM_computes C e x).mono ?_
    calc (C + 5 * e + 17) * ((x.length + 1) ^ e + x.length + 1)
        ≤ (C + 5 * e + 17) * (2 * (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1)) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
      _ = 2 * (C + 5 * e + 17) * (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  · refine (ComputesInTime.spaceUsed_le (pairLenCheckTM_computes C e x) t).trans ?_
    dsimp only
    have hQ : 1 ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ e + x.length + 1 := by omega
    generalize (x.length + 1) ^ e + x.length + 1 = Q at hQ ⊢
    calc (pairLenCheckTM C e).k * ((C + 5 * e + 17) * Q + 1)
        ≤ (pairLenCheckTM C e).k * ((C + 5 * e + 17 + 1) * Q) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by
            have : (C + 5 * e + 17 + 1) * Q = (C + 5 * e + 17) * Q + Q := by ring
            omega)
      _ = (pairLenCheckTM C e).k * (C + 5 * e + 17 + 1) * Q := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _)

/-- **Space row** `Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_stripLast_spaceUsed`, statement unchanged: the
linear time spec gives linear space, and the row's quadratic time clause is slack. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_computesFunInTime_stripLast_spaceUsed :

  refine ⟨stripLastTM, 150 + stripLastTM.k * 151, fun x => ?_, fun x t => ?_⟩
  · refine (stripLastTM_computes x).mono ?_
    calc 150 * (x.length + 1) ≤ 150 * (x.length + 1) ^ 2 :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.le_self_pow (by norm_num) _)
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  · refine (ComputesInTime.spaceUsed_le (stripLastTM_computes x) t).trans ?_
    calc stripLastTM.k * (150 * (x.length + 1) + 1) ≤ stripLastTM.k * (151 * (x.length + 1)) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
      _ = stripLastTM.k * 151 * (x.length + 1) := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _)

constant for both specs. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_computesFunInTime_splitSolve_spaceUsed :
    type_of% @Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_splitSolve_spaceUsed := by
  intro C e
  refine ⟨splitSolveTM C e,
    (20 + 23 * (splitSolveTM C e).k) * ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 46),
    fun x => (splitSolveTM_computes C e x).mono
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _))),
    fun x t => (splitSolveTM_spaceUsed C e x t).trans ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.add_mul (20 : ℕ) (23 * (splitSolveTM C e).k), Nat.mul_assoc 23]
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _)

clause of the redirect correspondence. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_redirectTM_spaceUsedByTape :
    type_of% @Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_spaceUsedByTape := by
  intro M haltOn x t i

  congr 1

three specs of the timed conditional, with today's constant `7 + k₁ + k₂`. -/
theorem MIG1Gate.row_computesFunInTime_cond_spaceUsed :
    type_of% @Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond_spaceUsed := by
  intro D M₁ M₂ p f₁ f₂ T₀ T₁ T₂ sD s₁ s₂ hD h₁ h₂ hsD hs₁ hs₂
  refine ⟨timedCondTM D M₁ M₂, 7 + M₁.k + M₂.k, fun x => ?_, fun x t => ?_⟩
  · exact (timedCondTM_computes hD h₁ h₂ x).mono (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega))
  · have h := timedCondTM_spaceUsed D M₁ M₂ x (p x) (T₀ x.length) t (hD x)
    rw [branchTM_spaceUsed] at h
    have hd := hsD x (T₀ x.length)
    have h1 := hs₁ x t
    have h2 := hs₂ x t
    have hm1 := Nat.le_max_left (s₁ x.length) (s₂ x.length)
    have hm2 := Nat.le_max_right (s₁ x.length) (s₂ x.length)
    split at h <;> omega

/-- **Space row** `Turing.FinTM.exists_loopTM_spaceUsed`, statement unchanged: the decision
loop's time spec and the loop host's budget theorem, with constant `10 + 23·k`. The row's
fuel and body space hypotheses are not needed: the budget theorem bounds the space by

theorem MIG1Gate.row_exists_loopTM_spaceUsed :
    type_of% @Turing.FinTM.exists_loopTM_spaceUsed := by
  intro body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF s0 R T S hF hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround _ _ _
  refine ⟨loopHostTM body F anchor false, 10 + 23 * (loopHostTM body F anchor false).k,
    fun x => (loopHostTM_decides body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF s0 R T hF hInv0 hInvStep
      hstart hround x).mono (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _
        (Nat.le_add_right _ _))), fun x t => ?_⟩
  refine (loopHostTM_spaceUsed_le_budget body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF (fun _ _ => [true])
    false s0 R T hF hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround x t).trans ?_
  rw [Nat.add_mul 10]
  exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _)

private def catalogPolyTape (q : ℕ) (z : ℤ) : Option Bool :=
  if 0 ≤ z ∧ z < q then some true else none

private def catalogPolyCost (q C : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => C + 1
  | r + 1 => q * (catalogPolyCost q C r + 2) + q + 2

private def splitStep (w s : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  if s.length ≤ w.length then s ++ [true] else s

private def splitAccept (C e : ℕ) (w s : List Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (s.length + C * (s.length + 1) ^ e = w.length)

private def splitBank (M : FinTM Bool) (s : List Bool)
    (q : Option M.State) (out : List Bool) : Cfg M.k Bool M.State [] :=
  ⟨q, 1, fun _ => catalogPolyTape (s.length + 1), fun _ => 0, out⟩

private def emitterSplitAccept (f : ℕ → ℕ) (w s : List Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (s.length + f s.length = w.length)

-- @shim begin (statement shim: Catalog's private `f2_loopHost_contracts`, re-targeted by the
-- rename `f2_loopHost → loopHostTM`, with its witness `c = f2_loopHost_bound = 10` made explicit:
-- its proof opens with `refine ⟨f2_loopHost_bound, ?_⟩`, `Build/Catalog.lean:8167`)
private lemma loopHost_contracts_heads (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)
    (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (findMode : Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if acceptF x s then
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state
              = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output
              = out x s
        else
          body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) :
    ∀ x : List Bool,
      ∃ (cfg : ℕ → Cfg (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).k Bool
          (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).State x) (startup : ℕ),
        startup ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1) ∧
        (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
          ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.initCfg x) startup = cfg 0 ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, (cfg i).output = []) ∧
        (cfg (R x.length + 1)).state = none ∧
        (cfg (R x.length + 1)).output = (if findMode then [] else [false]) ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, ∃ t ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1),
          if acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) then
            ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).state = none ∧
            ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).output =
              (if findMode then out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) else [true])
          else (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t = cfg (i + 1)) ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, ∀ j,
          -(T x.length : ℤ) ≤ (cfg i).workTapePos j ∧
          (cfg i).workTapePos j ≤ T x.length) ∧
        (∀ j, -((T x.length + 10 * (T x.length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤
          (cfg (R x.length + 1)).workTapePos j ∧
          (cfg (R x.length + 1)).workTapePos j ≤
            (T x.length + 10 * (T x.length + 1) : ℕ)) := by
  sorry
-- @shim end

/-- Probe of `polyUnaryTM_computes`. -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_polyUnaryTM_computes : type_of% @polyUnaryTM_computes := by
  intro C e x
  cases e with
  | zero =>
    simp only [polyUnaryTM, pow_zero, Nat.mul_one]
    exact (constTM_computes (List.replicate C true) x).mono (by simp)
  | succ d => exact catalogPoly_unary_computes d C x

/-- Probe of `pairLenCheckTM_computes`. -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_pairLenCheckTM_computes : type_of% @pairLenCheckTM_computes := by
  intro C e
  have hlen (x : List Bool) : (((pairDecode x).map Prod.fst).getD []).length ≤ x.length := by
    cases hd : pairDecode x with
    | none => simp
    | some ab =>
      rcases ab with ⟨a, b⟩
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.getD_some]
      rw [Turing.eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode x a b hd, length_pairEncode]
      omega
  have hG : (bufferedCompTM (pairExtractTM true false) (polyUnaryTM C e)).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => List.replicate
        (C * ((((pairDecode x).map Prod.fst).getD []).length + 1) ^ e) true)
      (fun n => (C + 5 * e + 12) * ((n + 1) ^ e + n + 1)) := by
    intro x
    have hpow := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.add_le_add_right (hlen x) 1) e
    have h := bufferedCompTM_computesInTime _ _ (pairExtractTM_fst x)
      (polyUnaryTM_computes C e (((pairDecode x).map Prod.fst).getD []))
    refine h.mono ?_
    dsimp only
    have := hlen x
    have h3 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (C + 5 * e + 4) hpow
    generalize (x.length + 1) ^ e = P at h3 ⊢
    generalize ((((pairDecode x).map Prod.fst).getD []).length + 1) ^ e = P' at h3 ⊢
    have h4 : (C + 5 * e + 12) * (P + x.length + 1) =
        (C + 5 * e + 4) * P + 8 * P + (C + 5 * e + 12) * (x.length + 1) := by ring
    have h5 : 8 * (x.length + 1) ≤ (C + 5 * e + 12) * (x.length + 1) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
    omega
  intro x
  have h := pairCount_computes hG x
  have hh : (pairLenCheckTM C e).ComputesInTime x
      [match pairDecode x with
        | some (a, b) => decide (b.length ≤ C * (a.length + 1) ^ e)
        | none => false]
      ((C + 5 * e + 12) * ((x.length + 1) ^ e + x.length + 1) + 2 * x.length + 5) := by
    cases hd : pairDecode x with
    | none => simpa [pairLenCheckTM, hd] using h
    | some uv => cases uv; simpa [pairLenCheckTM, hd] using h
  refine hh.mono ?_
  dsimp only
  generalize (x.length + 1) ^ e = P
  have h6 : (C + 5 * e + 17) * (P + x.length + 1) =
      (C + 5 * e + 12) * (P + x.length + 1) + 5 * (P + x.length + 1) := by ring
  omega

/-- Probe of `stripLastTM_computes`. -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_stripLastTM_computes : type_of% @stripLastTM_computes := by
  have hD := bufferedCompTM_computesFunInTime pairExtractTM_snd anyTrue_computes
    (by intro m n h; exact Nat.add_le_add_right h 1)
  have hE : (constTM []).ComputesFunInTime (fun _ => []) (fun _ => 1) :=
    fun x => constTM_computes [] x
  have hM := timedCondTM_computes (p := fun x => ((pairDecode x).map Prod.snd |>.getD []).any id)
    hD rawStrip_computes hE
  intro x
  have hm := hM x
  have hh : stripLastTM.ComputesInTime x
      (match pairDecode x with
        | some (u, v) => match splitAtLastTrue v with
          | some w => pairEncode u w
          | none => []
        | none => [])
      (5 * (2 * (5 * (x.length + 1) + (5 * (x.length + 1) + 1) + 1) +
        max (4 * (x.length + 1)) 1 + 1)) := by
    cases hd : pairDecode x with
    | none => simpa [stripLastTM, hd] using hm
    | some uv =>
      rcases uv with ⟨u, v⟩
      rcases catalogMarker_cases v with ⟨ha, hs⟩ | ⟨w, ha, hs, hp⟩
      · simpa [stripLastTM, hd, ha, hs] using hm
      · have hx : splitAtLastTrue x = some (pairEncode u w) := by
          rw [Turing.eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode x u v hd]
          exact hp _
        simpa [stripLastTM, hd, ha, hs, hx] using hm
  refine hh.mono ?_
  dsimp only
  have : max (4 * (x.length + 1)) 1 = 4 * (x.length + 1) := max_eq_left (by omega)
  omega

/-- The split-search round contracts in the loop's hypothesis form, for any exact unary source
(today's `splitSolve_source`, with the round budget `(A + 5)·(n + 1)^(e + 1)`). -/
private theorem MIG1Probe.split_hyps (C e : ℕ) (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (B : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hsource : ∀ s : List Bool, M.tm.runFrom (splitBank M s (some start) []) (B s.length) =
      splitBank M s none (List.replicate (C * (s.length + 1) ^ e) true))
    (hbound : ∀ l, B l ≤ (C + 1 + 5 * e) * (l + 1) ^ e + 1) :
    (∀ w : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1),
      (∀ t' < t, ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.initCfg w)
        t').state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      (splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.initCfg w) t =
        Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k [])) ∧
    (∀ (w s : List Bool), s.length ≤ w.length + 1 →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor
            (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k s)) t').state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
        if splitAccept C e w s then
          ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor
            (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k s)) t).state = none ∧
          ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor
            (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k s)) t).output =
              pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
        else
          (splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor
            (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k (splitStep w s))) := by
  refine ⟨fun w => ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, fun j hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero _),
    splitBody_start M start w⟩, fun w s hs => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨t, htpos, ht, hsafe, hend⟩ := splitBody_round M start w s
    (List.replicate (C * (s.length + 1) ^ e) true) (B s.length) (hsource s)
  refine ⟨t, htpos, (ht.trans (splitBody_envelope C e s.length w.length (B s.length) hs
    (hbound s.length))).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _)), hsafe, ?_⟩
  simpa only [splitAccept, List.length_replicate] using hend

/-- The two exact unary sources of `splitSolveTM` (today's `splitSolve_closed`). -/
private theorem MIG1Probe.split_sources (C e : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (B : ℕ → ℕ),
      splitSolveTM C e = loopHostTM (splitBodyTM M start) lengthBitsTM .anchor true ∧
      (∀ s : List Bool, M.tm.runFrom (splitBank M s (some start) []) (B s.length) =
        splitBank M s none (List.replicate (C * (s.length + 1) ^ e) true)) ∧
      (∀ l, B l ≤ (C + 1 + 5 * e) * (l + 1) ^ e + 1) := by
  cases e with
  | zero =>
    exact ⟨prependTM (List.replicate C true), (0 : Fin ((List.replicate C true).length + 1)),
      fun _ => C + 1, rfl, fun s => by simpa using splitSource_constant C s, fun l => by simp⟩
  | succ e =>
    exact ⟨catalogPolyUnaryTM e C, .loop (Fin.last e),
      fun l => catalogPolyCost (l + 1) C (e + 1) + 1, rfl, splitSource_poly e C,
      fun l => Nat.add_le_add_right (catalogPolyCost_le (l + 1) C (by omega) (e + 1)) 1⟩

/-- The length counter at the split search's round budget. -/
private theorem MIG1Probe.split_fuel (C e : ℕ) :
    lengthBitsTM.ComputesFunInTime (fun w => Nat.bits (id w.length))
      (fun n => ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)) := by
  intro w
  refine (lengthBitsTM_computes w).mono ?_
  have hn : w.length + 1 ≤ (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) := Nat.le_self_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero e) _
  exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 5 hn).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _))

/-- Probe of `splitSolveTM_computes`. -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_splitSolveTM_computes : type_of% @splitSolveTM_computes := by
  intro C e
  obtain ⟨M, start, B, heq, hsource, hbound⟩ := MIG1Probe.split_sources C e
  obtain ⟨hstart, hround⟩ := MIG1Probe.split_hyps C e M start B hsource hbound
  rw [heq]
  have hM := loopHostTM_finds (splitBodyTM M start) lengthBitsTM .anchor
    (fun w s => s.length ≤ w.length + 1) splitStep (splitAccept C e)
    (fun w s => pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)) (fun _ => [])
    id (fun n => ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1))
    (MIG1Probe.split_fuel C e) (by intro w; simp) splitStep_inv hstart hround
  intro w
  have hm := hM w
  dsimp only [id_eq] at hm
  have hb : 10 * (((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) + 1) *
      (w.length + 2) ≤ 20 * ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 46) * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 2) :=
    (splitLoop_bound 10 ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) e w.length).trans
      (le_of_eq (by ring))
  convert hm.mono hb using 1
  exact (splitLoop_result C e w).symm

/-- Probe of `loopHostTM_spaceUsed_le_budget`: the space half of `f2_exists_loopFind_space`,
which uses nothing about the mode. -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_loopHostTM_spaceUsed_le_budget :
    type_of% @loopHostTM_spaceUsed_le_budget := by
  intro body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF out findMode s0 R T hF hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround x t
  let E := loopHostTM body F anchor findMode
  obtain ⟨cfg, startup, hs, hinit, _, hend, _, hsegments, hheads, hterminal⟩ :=
    loopHost_contracts_heads body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF out findMode s0 R T hF hInv0
      hInvStep hstart hround x
  have h := f2_seamed_space E x cfg (R x.length + 1) (10 * (T x.length + 1))
    (T x.length) startup hs hinit (fun j hj => hheads j (by omega)) hend hterminal
    (by
      intro j hj
      obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := hsegments j (by omega)
      refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
      split at he
      · exact Or.inl he.1
      · exact Or.inr he) t
  have hb : 2 * (T x.length + 10 * (T x.length + 1)) + 1 ≤ 23 * (T x.length + 1) := by omega
  calc
    _ ≤ E.k * (23 * (T x.length + 1)) := h.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hb)
    _ = 23 * E.k * (T x.length + 1) := by ring

/-- Probe of `splitSolveTM_spaceUsed`, from the budget theorem. -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_splitSolveTM_spaceUsed : type_of% @splitSolveTM_spaceUsed := by
  intro C e x t
  obtain ⟨M, start, B, heq, hsource, hbound⟩ := MIG1Probe.split_sources C e
  obtain ⟨hstart, hround⟩ := MIG1Probe.split_hyps C e M start B hsource hbound
  rw [heq]
  refine (loopHostTM_spaceUsed_le_budget (splitBodyTM M start) lengthBitsTM .anchor
    (fun w s => s.length ≤ w.length + 1) splitStep (splitAccept C e)
    (fun w s => pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)) true (fun _ => [])
    id (fun n => ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1))
    (MIG1Probe.split_fuel C e) (by intro w; simp) splitStep_inv hstart hround x t).trans ?_
  have hp : 1 ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (Nat.succ_pos _)
  generalize (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) = P at hp ⊢
  generalize (C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e = A
  calc 23 * (loopHostTM (splitBodyTM M start) lengthBitsTM .anchor true).k *
        ((A + 40 + 5) * P + 1)
      ≤ 23 * (loopHostTM (splitBodyTM M start) lengthBitsTM .anchor true).k *
        ((A + 46) * P) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by
          have : (A + 46) * P = (A + 40 + 5) * P + P := by ring
          omega)
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Probe of `splitSolveWithTM_computes` (today's `emitterP2_closed` and
`emitterSplit_of_body`, with every existential named). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_splitSolveWithTM_computes : type_of% @splitSolveWithTM_computes := by
  intro f E TE hTE hE
  let C := callTM E false
  let D := callTM lengthBitsTM false
  let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D (callTM_k_pos E false) (callTM_k_pos lengthBitsTM false)
    (callEntry E false) (callExit E false) (callEntry lengthBitsTM false)
    (callExit lengthBitsTM false)
  let A := 2 * (24 + 13 * E.k) + (24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) * (2 * 5 + 1) + 10 * (5 + 8)
  -- the install-call contracts of the two named calls, from `callTM_run`
  have hCall (M : FinTM Bool) (g : List Bool → List Bool) (Tg : ℕ → ℕ)
      (hg : M.ComputesFunInTime g Tg) (x arg : List Bool) :
      ∃ t ≤ (24 + 13 * M.k) * (Tg arg.length + arg.length + (g arg).length + 1), 0 < t ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t → ((callTM M false).tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M false) (stateWord (callTM M false).k arg))
            t').state ≠ some (callExit M false)) ∧
        (callTM M false).tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M false) (stateWord (callTM M false).k arg)) t =
            Cfg.ofWords (callExit M false) (stateWord (callTM M false).k (g arg)) := by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hpos, hfirst, hr⟩ := callTM_run M false x arg (g arg) (Tg arg.length) (hg arg)
    exact ⟨t, ht, hpos, fun j _ hj => hfirst j hj, by simpa using hr⟩
  have hstart : ∀ w : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ (A + 5) * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2),
      (∀ t' < t, (B.tm.runFrom (B.tm.initCfg w) t').state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      B.tm.runFrom (B.tm.initCfg w) t = Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord B.k []) := fun w =>
    ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, fun j hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero _),
      emitterP2_body_start C D _ _ _ _ _ _ w⟩
  have hround : ∀ (w s : List Bool), s.length ≤ w.length + 1 →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ (A + 5) * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2) ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord B.k s)) t').state
            ≠ some .anchor) ∧
        if emitterSplitAccept f w s then
          (B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord B.k s)) t).state = none ∧
          (B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord B.k s)) t).output =
            pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
        else
          B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord B.k s)) t =
            Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord B.k (splitStep w s)) := by
    intro w s hs
    have hL := lengthBitsTM_computes
    let H := TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2
    let u := Nat.bits (f s.length)
    let v := Nat.bits (w.drop s.length).length
    obtain ⟨_, hu, hmono⟩ := emitter_width_budget f E TE hTE hE w s hs
    have hdrop : (w.drop s.length).length ≤ w.length := by
      simp only [List.length_drop]; omega
    have hv : v.length ≤ 5 * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1) := by
      have hout := ((computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp (hL (w.drop s.length))).2
      simpa only [hout, v] using lengthBitsTM.tm.output_length_le (w.drop s.length)
        (5 * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1))
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hap, haf, har⟩ := hCall E (fun s => Nat.bits (f s.length)) TE hE w s
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbp, hbf, hbr⟩ :=
      hCall lengthBitsTM (fun s => Nat.bits s.length) (fun n => 5 * (n + 1)) hL w
        (w.drop s.length)
    obtain ⟨t, htpos, ht, hfirst, hr⟩ := emitterP2_body_round f C D _ _ _ _ _ _
      w s a b hap hbp haf har hbf hbr
    refine ⟨t, htpos, ?_, hfirst, hr⟩
    have hHs : s.length ≤ H := by dsimp [H]; omega
    have hHn : w.length ≤ H := by dsimp [H]; omega
    have hHu : u.length ≤ H := by dsimp [u, H]; omega
    have hLd : 5 * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1) ≤ 5 * H :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left 5 (by dsimp [H]; omega)
    have hHv : v.length ≤ 5 * H := hv.trans hLd
    have hCa : TE s.length + s.length + u.length + 1 ≤ 2 * H := by
      dsimp [u, H]; omega
    have hCa' : a ≤ (2 * (24 + 13 * E.k)) * H := by
      calc
        a ≤ (24 + 13 * E.k) * (TE s.length + s.length + u.length + 1) := ha
        _ ≤ (24 + 13 * E.k) * (2 * H) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hCa
        _ = (2 * (24 + 13 * E.k)) * H := by ring
    have hDb : 5 * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1) + (w.drop s.length).length + v.length + 1 ≤
        (2 * 5 + 1) * H := by
      dsimp [H] at *; omega
    have hDb' : b ≤ ((24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) * (2 * 5 + 1)) * H := by
      calc
        b ≤ (24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) *
            (5 * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1) + (w.drop s.length).length + v.length + 1) :=
          hb
        _ ≤ (24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) * ((2 * 5 + 1) * H) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hDb
        _ = ((24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) * (2 * 5 + 1)) * H := by ring
    have hsum : s.length + w.length + u.length + v.length + 10 ≤ (5 + 8) * H := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul]
      omega
    calc
      t ≤ a + b + 10 * (s.length + w.length + u.length + v.length + 10) := ht
      _ ≤ (2 * (24 + 13 * E.k)) * H + ((24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) * (2 * 5 + 1)) * H +
          10 * ((5 + 8) * H) :=
        Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add hCa' hDb') (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hsum)
      _ = A * H := by dsimp [A]; ring
      _ ≤ (A + 5) * H := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  have hF : lengthBitsTM.ComputesFunInTime (fun w => Nat.bits (id w.length))
      (fun n => (A + 5) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2)) := by
    intro w
    refine (lengthBitsTM_computes w).mono ?_
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 5 (by omega : w.length + 1 ≤
      TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2)).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega))
  have hM := loopHostTM_finds B lengthBitsTM .anchor
    (fun w s => s.length ≤ w.length + 1) splitStep (emitterSplitAccept f)
    (fun w s => pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)) (fun _ => [])
    id (fun n => (A + 5) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2)) hF (by intro w; simp) splitStep_inv
    hstart hround
  intro w
  have hm := hM w
  dsimp only [id_eq] at hm
  have hb : 10 * ((A + 5) * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2) + 1) * (w.length + 2) ≤
      20 * (591 + 26 * E.k) * (w.length + 1) * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2) :=
    (emitterSplit_loop_bound 10 (A + 5) w.length (TE (w.length + 1))).trans
      (le_of_eq (by simp only [A, show lengthBitsTM.k = 1 from rfl]; ring))
  convert hm.mono hb using 1
  exact (emitterSplit_result f w).symm

end Turing.FinTM
