/-- Statement shim of `ifEq_run` (`Composition.lean:226`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma ifEq_run (w₀ u v x : List Bool) :
    ∀ (r i : ℕ) (hlen : w₀.length = i + r), i ≤ x.length → x.take i = w₀.take i →
    ∀ (cfg : Cfg 0 Bool (ifEqTM w₀ u v).State x),
      cfg.state = some (.inl ⟨i, by omega⟩) → cfg.inputPos.val = i + 1 → cfg.output = [] →
      ∃ t, t ≤ r + max u.length v.length + 2 ∧
        ((ifEqTM w₀ u v).tm.runFrom cfg t).state = none ∧
        ((ifEqTM w₀ u v).tm.runFrom cfg t).output = if x = w₀ then u else v := by
  sorry

/-- Statement shim of `condTM_start` (`Composition.lean:594`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma condTM_start (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (hD : ∃ t, D.ComputesInTime x [b] t) :
    ∃ (t : ℕ) (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ),
      (condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) t =
        rightCfg (fun q => .inr (.inr q)) ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) tapes heads := by
  sorry
private def redirectState {S : Type} (haltOn : Bool) (q : Option S)
    (r : Option Bool) : Option ((S × Option Bool) ⊕ Unit) :=
  match q with
  | some s => some (.inl (s, r))
  | none => if r = some haltOn then none else some (.inr ())

private def redirectCfg (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) : Cfg (redirectTM M haltOn).k Bool
      (redirectTM M haltOn).State x :=
  ⟨redirectState haltOn c.state c.output.getLast?, c.inputPos,
    c.workTapes, c.workTapePos, []⟩
/-- Statement shim of `redirect_run` (`Wrappers.lean:411`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma redirect_run (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t =
      redirectCfg M haltOn (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t) := by
  sorry
private def scanCfg {S : Type} (x : List Bool) (q : Option S)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) : Cfg 0 Bool S x :=
  ⟨q, ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩, fun j => j.elim0, fun j => j.elim0, out⟩
/-- Statement shim of `scanCfg_read` (`Primitives.lean:216`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma scanCfg_read {S : Type} (x : List Bool) (q : Option S)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) :
    (scanCfg x q i hi out).inputSymbol = x[i]? := by
  sorry

/-- Statement shim of `emitterToken_run` (`Primitives.lean:6150`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma emitterToken_run (x rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre out (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
      unaryTokenTM.tm.runFrom
        (scanCfg x (some (0 : Fin 6)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) out)
        (2 * (unaryTokenSplit rest).1.length + (unaryTokenSplit rest).2.length + 3) =
        scanCfg x none x.length (by omega)
          (out ++ pairEncode (unaryTokenSplit rest).1 (unaryTokenSplit rest).2) := by
  sorry

/-- Statement shim of `emitterToken_length` (`Primitives.lean:6210`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma emitterToken_length (x : List Bool) :
    (unaryTokenSplit x).1.length + (unaryTokenSplit x).2.length = x.length := by
  sorry

/-- Statement shim of `emitterAppend_run` (`Primitives.lean:6264`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma emitterAppend_run (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    ∀ j (hj : j ≤ x.length),
      (appendBitTM b).tm.runFrom ((appendBitTM b).tm.initCfg x) j =
        scanCfg x (some ()) j hj (x.take j) := by
  sorry
/-- Statement shim of `loop_halted_run` (`Loop.lean:2296`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma loop_halted_run {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x)
    (accept : ℕ → Bool) (B N : ℕ)
    (hend : (cfg N).state = none ∧ (cfg N).output = [false])
    (hround : ∀ j < N, ∃ t ≤ B,
      if accept j then
        (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).state = none ∧
          (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).output = [true]
      else tm.runFrom (cfg j) t = cfg (j + 1)) :
    ∃ t ≤ N * B, (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).output = [(List.range N).any accept] := by
  sorry

/-- Statement shim of `loop_find_run` (`Loop.lean:2435`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma loop_find_run {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x)
    (accept : ℕ → Bool) (payload : ℕ → List Bool) (B N : ℕ)
    (hend : (cfg N).state = none ∧ (cfg N).output = [])
    (hround : ∀ j < N, ∃ t ≤ B,
      if accept j then
        (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).state = none ∧
          (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).output = payload j
      else tm.runFrom (cfg j) t = cfg (j + 1)) :
    ∃ t ≤ N * B, (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).output =
        (match (List.range N).find? accept with | some i => payload i | none => []) := by
  sorry
/-- Statement shim of `emCall_first` (`Loop.lean:4592`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma emCall_first (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesInTime arg cap T) :
    ∃ t ≤ (24 + 13 * M.k) * (T + arg.length + cap.length + 1),
      0 < t ∧
      (∀ j < t, ((callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callTM M emit).tm.q₀ (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) j).state
          ≠ some (.inr (.inr (5 : Fin 6)))) ∧
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callTM M emit).tm.q₀ (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) t =
        { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (.inr (.inr (5 : Fin 6)) : emCallState M)
            (stateWord (callTM M emit).k (if emit then arg else cap))
          with output := if emit then cap else [] } := by
  sorry
private def fwdMapVirtual (M : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State y) (tag : Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (a pre : List Bool) : Cfg (1 + (1 + M.k)) Bool (FwdMapState M.State) x where
  state := c.state.map (fun q => .run q tag)
  inputPos := p
  workTapes := tapeBlocks (fun _ => bufferTape a) (bufferTape y) c.workTapes
  workTapePos := tapeBlocks (fun _ => (a.length : ℤ)) ((c.inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1) c.workTapePos
  output := pre ++ c.output
/-- Statement shim of `fwdMapVirtual_run` (`Catalog.lean:5628`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma fwdMapVirtual_run (M : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State y) (tag : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos tag)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (a pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ tag', VirtualTag (M.tm.runFrom c t).inputPos tag' ∧
      (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom (fwdMapVirtual M c tag p a pre) t =
        fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.runFrom c t) tag' p a pre := by
  sorry

/-- Statement shim of `fwdMapSetup_heads` (`Catalog.lean:5729`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma fwdMapSetup_heads (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin M.k) :
    ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos
      (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) = 0 := by
  sorry

/-- Statement shim of `fwdMap_launch` (`Catalog.lean:5740`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma fwdMap_launch (M : FinTM Bool) (x a b : List Bool)
    (hd : pairDecode x = some (a, b)) :
    ∃ u ≤ 5 * (x.length + 1),
      (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u =
        fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.initCfg b) true ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ a (pairEncode a []) ∧
      ∀ v ≤ u, (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) v =
        (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) v := by
  sorry

/-- Statement shim of `fwdMap_reject` (`Catalog.lean:5774`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma fwdMap_reject (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (hd : pairDecode x = none) :
    ∃ u ≤ 5 * (x.length + 1),
      ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).state = none ∧
      ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).output = [] ∧
      ∀ v, (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) v =
        (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) v := by
  sorry

/-- Statement shim of `fwdMap_space` (`Catalog.lean:5841`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma fwdMap_space (M : FinTM Bool) (x y : List Bool) (t D S : ℕ)
    (hfirst : ∀ u ≤ t, -(D : ℤ) ≤
        ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.castAdd (1 + M.k) (0 : Fin 1)) ∧
      ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.castAdd (1 + M.k) (0 : Fin 1)) ≤ D)
    (hsecond : ∀ u ≤ t, -(D : ℤ) ≤
        ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd M.k (0 : Fin 1))) ∧
      ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd M.k (0 : Fin 1))) ≤ D)
    (hsource : ∀ i, (fwdMapTM M true).tm.visitedByTapeHead ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) t
        (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) ⊆ M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg y) t i)
    (hs : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg y) t ≤ S) :
    (fwdMapTM M true).tm.spaceUsed ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) t ≤ S + 2 * (2 * D + 1) := by
  sorry
/-- Statement shim of `catalogPoly_space` (`Catalog.lean:3288`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma catalogPoly_space (d C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.spaceUsed
      ((catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.initCfg x) t ≤
        (5 * (d + 1)) * (x.length + 1) := by
  sorry
-- @shim end

/-- Probe of `callTM_run`: today's `emCall_first` itself, the named states unfolding. -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_callTM_run : type_of% @callTM_run :=
  fun M emit x arg cap T hM => emCall_first M emit x arg cap T hM

/-- Probe of `idTM_computes` (the body of `computesFunInTime_id`). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_idTM_computes : type_of% @idTM_computes := by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨hstate, hpos, hout⟩ := idTM_run x x.length (le_refl _)
  have h0 : (idTM.tm.runFrom (idTM.tm.initCfg x) x.length).inputPos ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hpos
    simp at hpos
  have hsym : (idTM.tm.runFrom (idTM.tm.initCfg x) x.length).inputSymbol = none := by
    unfold Cfg.inputSymbol
    rw [dif_neg h0, dif_pos (by omega)]
  have hrun1 : idTM.tm.runFrom (idTM.tm.initCfg x) (x.length + 1) =
      (idTM.tm.tr () none
        ((idTM.tm.runFrom (idTM.tm.initCfg x) x.length).workTapeSymbols)).apply
        (idTM.tm.runFrom (idTM.tm.initCfg x) x.length) := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
    unfold MultiTapeTM.step
    rw [hstate]
    dsimp only
    rw [hsym]
  refine ⟨_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
  · rw [hrun1]
    simp [idTM, Action.apply]
  · rw [hrun1]
    simp only [idTM, Action.apply]
    rw [hout]
    simp

/-- Probe of `ifEqTM_computes` (the body of `computesFunInTime_ifEq`). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_ifEqTM_computes : type_of% @ifEqTM_computes := by
  intro w₀ u v x
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hs, ho⟩ := ifEq_run w₀ u v x w₀.length 0 (by omega) (by omega) rfl
    ((ifEqTM w₀ u v).tm.initCfg x) rfl (by simp) rfl
  have hbase : (ifEqTM w₀ u v).ComputesInTime x (if x = w₀ then u else v) t :=
    ⟨_, hs, ho, rfl⟩
  exact hbase.mono (Nat.le_trans (by omega) (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)))

/-- Probe of `condTM_computes_iff` (the body of `exists_cond`). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_condTM_computes_iff : type_of% @condTM_computes_iff := by
  intro D M₁ M₂ p hD x w
  obtain ⟨a, tapes, heads, ha⟩ := condTM_start D M₁ M₂ x (p x) (hD x)
  have hr (t : ℕ) :
      (condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) (a + t) =
        rightCfg (fun q => .inr (.inr q))
          ((branchTM M₁ M₂ (p x)).tm.runFrom ((branchTM M₁ M₂ (p x)).tm.initCfg x) t)
          tapes heads := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, ha]
    exact rightCfg_run (branchTM M₁ M₂ (p x)).tm (condTM D M₁ M₂).tm
      (fun q => .inr (.inr q)) (fun _ _ _ => rfl) _ tapes heads t
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    have hc := (computesInTime_iff (condTM D M₁ M₂) x w (a + t)).mp
      (ht.mono (by omega))
    rw [hr t] at hc
    have hb : (branchTM M₁ M₂ (p x)).ComputesInTime x w t :=
      (computesInTime_iff _ x w t).mpr
        ⟨by simpa only [rightCfg, Option.map_eq_none_iff] using hc.1, hc.2⟩
    exact ⟨t, (branchTM_computes M₁ M₂ (p x) x w t).mp hb⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    have hb := (computesInTime_iff (branchTM M₁ M₂ (p x)) x w t).mp
      ((branchTM_computes M₁ M₂ (p x) x w t).mpr ht)
    refine ⟨a + t, (computesInTime_iff _ x w (a + t)).mpr ?_⟩
    rw [hr t]
    exact ⟨by simpa only [rightCfg, Option.map_eq_none_iff] using hb.1, hb.2⟩

/-- Probe of `redirectTM_runFrom` (the fields of `redirect_run`). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_redirectTM_runFrom : type_of% @redirectTM_runFrom := by
  intro M haltOn x t
  rw [redirect_run]
  refine ⟨?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  generalize M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t = c
  rcases c with ⟨q, p, tapes, heads, out⟩
  cases q <;> rfl

/-- Probe of `unaryTokenTM_computes` (the body of `computesFunInTime_unaryToken`). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_unaryTokenTM_computes : type_of% @unaryTokenTM_computes := by
  intro x
  have hr := emitterToken_run x x [] [] rfl
  have hc : unaryTokenTM.ComputesInTime x
      (pairEncode (unaryTokenSplit x).1 (unaryTokenSplit x).2)
      (2 * (unaryTokenSplit x).1.length + (unaryTokenSplit x).2.length + 3) := by
    apply (FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr
    have hinit : unaryTokenTM.tm.initCfg x =
        scanCfg x (some (0 : Fin 6)) 0 (by omega) [] := by
      apply Cfg.ext_zero_tapes <;> simp [unaryTokenTM, scanCfg]
    rw [hinit]
    constructor
    · simpa only [List.length_nil, scanCfg] using congrArg Cfg.state hr
    · simpa only [List.length_nil, List.nil_append, scanCfg] using congrArg Cfg.output hr
  apply hc.mono
  change 2 * (unaryTokenSplit x).1.length + (unaryTokenSplit x).2.length + 3 ≤
    3 * (x.length + 1)
  have hl := emitterToken_length x
  omega

/-- Probe of `appendBitTM_computes` (the body of `computesFunInTime_appendBit`). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_appendBitTM_computes : type_of% @appendBitTM_computes := by
  intro b x
  apply (FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr
  rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', emitterAppend_run b x x.length (by omega)]
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  change let d := ((appendBitTM b).tm.tr ()
    (scanCfg x (some ()) x.length (by omega) (x.take x.length)).inputSymbol _).apply _
    d.Halted ∧ d.output = x ++ [b]
  rw [scanCfg_read]
  simp [appendBitTM, scanCfg, Action.apply, Cfg.Halted]

/-- Probe of `loopHostTM_decides` (the body of `exists_loopTM`, from the gated contract). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_loopHostTM_decides : type_of% @loopHostTM_decides := by
  intro body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF s0 R T hF hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround x
  have hc := loopHostTM_contracts body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF (fun _ _ => [true]) false
    s0 R T hF hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround
  let E := loopHostTM body F anchor false
  obtain ⟨cfg, startup, hs, hinit, _, hend, hout, hsegments⟩ := hc x
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hhalt, houtput⟩ := loop_halted_run E.tm cfg
    (fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))) (10 * (T x.length + 1))
    (R x.length + 1) ⟨hend, by simpa using hout⟩
    (fun j hj => by simpa using hsegments j (by omega))
  have hrun := E.tm.runFrom_add (E.tm.initCfg x) startup t
  rw [hinit] at hrun
  have hcompute : E.ComputesInTime x
      [(List.range (R x.length + 1)).any
        (fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)))] (startup + t) := by
    refine ⟨_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
    · rw [hrun]; exact hhalt
    · rw [hrun]; exact houtput
  apply hcompute.mono
  calc startup + t ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1) +
        (R x.length + 1) * (10 * (T x.length + 1)) := Nat.add_le_add hs ht
    _ = 10 * (T x.length + 1) * (R x.length + 2) := by ring

/-- Probe of `loopHostTM_finds` (the body of `exists_loopFindTM`, from the gated contract). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_loopHostTM_finds : type_of% @loopHostTM_finds := by
  intro body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF out s0 R T hF hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround x
  have hc := loopHostTM_contracts body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF out true s0 R T
    hF hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround
  let E := loopHostTM body F anchor true
  obtain ⟨cfg, startup, hs, hinit, _, hend, hout, hsegments⟩ := hc x
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hhalt, houtput⟩ := loop_find_run E.tm cfg
    (fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)))
    (fun i => out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))) (10 * (T x.length + 1)) (R x.length + 1)
    ⟨hend, by simpa using hout⟩
    (fun j hj => by simpa using hsegments j (by omega))
  have hrun := E.tm.runFrom_add (E.tm.initCfg x) startup t
  rw [hinit] at hrun
  have hcompute : E.ComputesInTime x
      (match (List.range (R x.length + 1)).find?
          (fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))) with
        | some i => out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))
        | none => []) (startup + t) := by
    refine ⟨_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
    · rw [hrun]; exact hhalt
    · rw [hrun]; exact houtput
  apply hcompute.mono
  calc startup + t ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1) +
        (R x.length + 1) * (10 * (T x.length + 1)) := Nat.add_le_add hs ht
    _ = 10 * (T x.length + 1) * (R x.length + 2) := by ring

/-- Probe of `polyUnaryTM_spaceUsed` (no work tapes at `e = 0`; Catalog's `f2_poly_space`,
renamed to the engine, at `e = d + 1`). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_polyUnaryTM_spaceUsed : type_of% @polyUnaryTM_spaceUsed := by
  intro C e x t
  cases e with
  | zero =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_zero_tapes_eq_zero _ _ rfl]
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  | succ d => exact catalogPoly_space d C x t

/-- Probe of `pairMapSndTM_computes` (the time half of `computesFunInTime_pairMapSnd_spaceUsed`,
over the moved forwarding family). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_pairMapSndTM_computes : type_of% @pairMapSndTM_computes := by
  intro Mg g Tg hg hTg x
  unfold pairMapSndTM
  let M := fwdMapTM Mg true
  cases hd : pairDecode x with
  | none =>
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hh, ho, _⟩ := fwdMap_reject Mg x hd
    have ht : M.ComputesInTime x [] u := ⟨_, hh, ho, rfl⟩
    simpa only [hd] using ht.mono (show u ≤ 22 * (x.length + 1 + Tg x.length) by omega)
  | some ab =>
    rcases ab with ⟨a, b⟩
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hinit, _⟩ := fwdMap_launch Mg x a b hd
    have hlen : b.length ≤ x.length := by
      have h := congrArg List.length (eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode x a b hd)
      rw [length_pairEncode] at h
      omega
    obtain ⟨tag, _, hr⟩ := fwdMapVirtual_run Mg (x := x) (Mg.tm.initCfg b) true
      (by simp [VirtualTag, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init])
      (⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩) a (pairEncode a []) (Tg b.length)
    obtain ⟨space, hh, ho, _⟩ := hg b
    have hrun : M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) (u + Tg b.length) =
        fwdMapVirtual Mg (Mg.tm.runFrom (Mg.tm.initCfg b) (Tg b.length)) tag
          ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ a (pairEncode a []) := by
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hinit]
      exact hr
    have ht : M.ComputesInTime x (pairEncode a (g b)) (u + Tg b.length) := by
      refine ⟨_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
      · rw [hrun]
        change Option.map (fun q => FwdMapState.run q tag)
          (Mg.tm.runFrom (Mg.tm.initCfg b) (Tg b.length)).state = none
        rw [hh]
        rfl
      · rw [hrun]
        change pairEncode a [] ++
          (Mg.tm.runFrom (Mg.tm.initCfg b) (Tg b.length)).output = pairEncode a (g b)
        rw [ho]
        simp [pairEncode, List.append_assoc]
    have hT := hTg hlen
    simpa only [hd] using ht.mono
      (show u + Tg b.length ≤ 22 * (x.length + 1 + Tg x.length) by omega)

/-- Probe of `pairMapSndTM_spaceUsed` (the space half of the same row; the head bound now comes
from the gated `abs_workTapePos_runFrom_sub_le` instead of the copied `f2_head_steps`). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_pairMapSndTM_spaceUsed : type_of% @pairMapSndTM_spaceUsed := by
  intro Mg Sg hgs hSg x t
  unfold pairMapSndTM
  let M := fwdMapTM Mg true
  let D := 5 * (x.length + 1)
  have hshort (v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ D) (i : Fin M.k) :
      -(D : ℤ) ≤ (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos i ∧
      (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos i ≤ D := by
    have h := abs_le.mp (MultiTapeTM.abs_workTapePos_runFrom_sub_le M.tm (M.tm.initCfg x) v i)
    rw [show (M.tm.initCfg x).workTapePos i = 0 from rfl, sub_zero] at h
    constructor <;> omega
  cases hd : pairDecode x with
  | none =>
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hh, _, heq⟩ := fwdMap_reject Mg x hd
    have hheads (v : ℕ) (i : Fin M.k) :
        -(D : ℤ) ≤ (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos i ∧
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos i ≤ D := by
      by_cases hv : v ≤ u
      · exact hshort v (hv.trans hu) i
      · rw [show v = u + (v - u) by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add,
          MultiTapeTM.runFrom_of_halt _ hh]
        exact hshort u hu i
    have hp (i : Fin Mg.k) : M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg x) t
        (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) ⊆ Mg.tm.visitedByTapeHead (Mg.tm.initCfg x) t i := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
      change ((fwdMapTM Mg true).tm.runFrom _ v).workTapePos _ ∈ _
      rw [heq v, fwdMapSetup_heads]
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨0, by simp, rfl⟩
    have hs := fwdMap_space Mg x x t D (Sg x.length)
      (fun v _ => hheads v _) (fun v _ => hheads v _) hp (hgs x t)
    change M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ _ at hs
    dsimp only [D] at hs
    omega
  | some ab =>
    rcases ab with ⟨a, b⟩
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hinit, hprefix⟩ := fwdMap_launch Mg x a b hd
    have hlen : a.length ≤ x.length ∧ b.length ≤ x.length := by
      have h := congrArg List.length (eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode x a b hd)
      rw [length_pairEncode] at h
      omega
    have hrun (v : ℕ) : ∃ tag,
        M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) (u + v) =
          fwdMapVirtual Mg (Mg.tm.runFrom (Mg.tm.initCfg b) v) tag
            ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ a (pairEncode a []) := by
      obtain ⟨tag, _, he⟩ := fwdMapVirtual_run Mg (x := x) (Mg.tm.initCfg b) true
        (by simp [VirtualTag, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init])
        (⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩) a (pairEncode a []) v
      refine ⟨tag, ?_⟩
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hinit]
      exact he
    have ha (v : ℕ) : -(D : ℤ) ≤
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos (Fin.castAdd (1 + Mg.k) (0 : Fin 1)) ∧
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos
          (Fin.castAdd (1 + Mg.k) (0 : Fin 1)) ≤ D := by
      by_cases hv : v ≤ u
      · exact hshort v (hv.trans hu) _
      · obtain ⟨tag, he⟩ := hrun (v - u)
        rw [show v = u + (v - u) by omega, he]
        simp only [fwdMapVirtual, tapeBlocks_left]
        dsimp only [D]
        constructor <;> omega
    have hb (v : ℕ) : -(D : ℤ) ≤
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos
          (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd Mg.k (0 : Fin 1))) ∧
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos
          (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd Mg.k (0 : Fin 1))) ≤ D := by
      by_cases hv : v ≤ u
      · exact hshort v (hv.trans hu) _
      · obtain ⟨tag, he⟩ := hrun (v - u)
        rw [show v = u + (v - u) by omega, he]
        simp only [fwdMapVirtual, tapeBlocks_buffer]
        have hp := (Mg.tm.runFrom (Mg.tm.initCfg b) (v - u)).inputPos.isLt
        dsimp only [D]
        constructor <;> omega
    have hp (i : Fin Mg.k) : M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg x) t
        (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) ⊆ Mg.tm.visitedByTapeHead (Mg.tm.initCfg b) t i := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
      have hvt : v ≤ t := by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hv; omega
      by_cases hvu : v ≤ u
      · change ((fwdMapTM Mg true).tm.runFrom _ v).workTapePos _ ∈ _
        rw [hprefix v hvu, fwdMapSetup_heads]
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨0, by simp, rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨tag, he⟩ := hrun (v - u)
        change (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos _ ∈ _
        rw [show v = u + (v - u) by omega, he]
        simp only [fwdMapVirtual, tapeBlocks_right]
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v - u, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), rfl⟩
    have hs := fwdMap_space Mg x b t D (Sg x.length)
      (fun v _ => ha v) (fun v _ => hb v) hp ((hgs b t).trans (hSg hlen.2))
    change M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ _ at hs
    dsimp only [D] at hs
    omega

end Turing.FinTM

    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (out : List Bool) : Cfg 0 Bool (Fin 6) x :=

/-- Statement shim of `pairDiag_run` (`Encoding.lean:455`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma pairDiag_run (x : List Bool) :
    pairDiagTM.tm.runFrom (pairDiagTM.tm.initCfg x) (4 * x.length + 5) =
      pairDiagCfg x none ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ (pairEncode x x) := by
  sorry

/-- Probe of `pairDiagTM_computes` (the `have h` of `computesFunInTime_pairEncode_diag`). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_pairDiagTM_computes : type_of% @pairDiagTM_computes := by

import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Catalog
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# MIG-1 bridge and duplicate probe (not landed)

1. **The loop-host bridge** (design §11, risk 1). Catalog's 21 modified loop-host copies are
   stated for `f2_loopHost`, copied from an older `Build/Loop.lean` before the forwarding flag.
   With verbatim copies of both definition families, `rfl` shows that the old host is the
   current shared controller at `forward = false`, so the moved budget proofs can be re-targeted
   at `loopHostM _ _ _ false` (today's `loopHost`, the gate's `loopHostTM`) by rewriting alone.
2. **Duplicates of existing public declarations.** Four private Catalog lemmas of the region
   have the statements of `Fin.sum_univ_add` (Mathlib), `Turing.MultiTapeTM.timed_input_bound`
   and `Turing.eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode`; each `example` proves the copied statement
   (verbatim) by the public declaration in one term.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§1.2: the machine model.)
-/

namespace Turing.FinTM

-- @shim begin (verbatim from `Build/Catalog.lean`: the old loop host)
private def f2_loopBodyTM (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) : FinTM Bool where
  k := body.k + 1
  State := body.State × Bool
  tm :=
    { q₀ := (body.tm.q₀, false)
      tr := fun q inp work =>
        if q.1 = anchor ∧ q.2 = false then
          { inputTape := 0
            workTapes := fun i =>
              if (i : ℕ) < body.k then (none, 0) else (some (some false), 0)
            output := none
            state := none }
        else
          let a := body.tm.tr q.1 inp (fun i => work i.castSucc)
          { inputTape := a.inputTape
            workTapes := fun i =>
              if h : (i : ℕ) < body.k then a.workTapes ⟨i, h⟩
              else (if a.state = none then some (some true) else none, 0)
            output := a.output
            state := a.state.map (fun s => (s, false)) } }

private abbrev f2_LoopHostState (body F : FinTM Bool) :=
  F.State ⊕ ((Bool × (body.State × Bool)) ⊕ Fin 14)

private def f2_loopFuelSource (body F : FinTM Bool) :
    MultiTapeTM (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) Bool F.State where
  q₀ := F.tm.q₀
  tr := fun q inp work =>
    rightAction (body.k + 1) id (rightAction 1 id
      (F.tm.tr q inp fun i => work (Fin.natAdd (body.k + 1) (Fin.natAdd 1 i))))

private def f2_loopBodySource (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) :
    MultiTapeTM (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) Bool (body.State × Bool) where
  q₀ := (body.tm.q₀, false)
  tr := fun q inp work => leftAction (1 + F.k) id
    ((f2_loopBodyTM body anchor).tm.tr q inp fun i => work (Fin.castAdd (1 + F.k) i))

private def f2_loopControlAction (body F : FinTM Bool) (inp : SignType)
    (flag : Option (Option Bool)) (counter payload : Option (Option Bool) × SignType)
    (out : Option Bool) (next : Option (f2_LoopHostState body F)) :
    Action (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (f2_LoopHostState body F) where
  inputTape := inp
  workTapes := fun i =>
    if (i : ℕ) = body.k then (flag, 0)
    else if (i : ℕ) = body.k + 1 then counter
    else if (i : ℕ) = body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) then payload
    else (none, 0)
  output := out
  state := next

private def f2_loopHost (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (findMode : Bool) :
    FinTM Bool where
  k := body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1
  State := f2_LoopHostState body F
  tm :=
    { q₀ := .inl F.tm.q₀
      tr := fun q inp work =>
        let ctrl (j : Fin 14) : f2_LoopHostState body F := .inr (.inr j)
        let call (startup : Bool) (s : body.State × Bool) : f2_LoopHostState body F :=
          .inr (.inl (startup, s))
        let flag : Fin (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) := ⟨body.k, by omega⟩
        let counter : Fin (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) := ⟨body.k + 1, by omega⟩
        let payload := Fin.last (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k))
        let act := f2_loopControlAction body F
        match q with
        | .inl s => captureAction Sum.inl (ctrl 0)
            ((f2_loopFuelSource body F).tr s inp fun i => work i.castSucc)
        | .inr (.inl (startup, s)) =>
            captureAction (call startup) (ctrl (if startup then 6 else 7))
              ((f2_loopBodySource body F anchor).tr s inp fun i => work i.castSucc)
        | .inr (.inr phase) =>
            if phase = 0 then act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 1))
            else if phase = 1 then
              match work payload with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 1))
              | none => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .pos) none (some (ctrl 2))
            else if phase = 2 then
              match work payload with
              | some b => act 0 none (some (some b), .pos) (some none, .pos) none
                  (some (ctrl 2))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 3))
            else if phase = 3 then
              match work counter with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 3))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .pos) (none, .pos) none (some (ctrl 4))
            else if phase = 4 then act .neg none (none, 0) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 5))
            else if phase = 5 then
              match inp with
              | some _ => act .neg none (none, 0) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 5))
              | none => act .pos none (none, 0) (none, 0) none
                  (some (call true (body.tm.q₀, false)))
            else if phase = 6 then act 0 (some none) (none, 0) (none, 0) none
              (some (call false (anchor, true)))
            else if phase = 7 then
              if work flag = some true then
                if findMode then act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 12))
                else act 0 none (none, 0) (none, 0) (some true) none
              else act 0 (some none) (none, 0) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 8))
            else if phase = 8 then
              match work counter with
              | some false => act 0 none (some (some true), .pos) (none, 0) none
                  (some (ctrl 8))
              | some true => act 0 none (some (some false), .neg) (none, 0) none
                  (some (ctrl 9))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 10))
            else if phase = 9 then
              match work counter with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 9))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .pos) (none, 0) none
                  (some (call false (anchor, true)))
            else if phase = 10 then
              match work counter with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 10))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .pos) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 11))
            else if phase = 11 then
              act 0 none (none, 0) (none, 0) (if findMode then none else some false) none
            else if phase = 12 then
              match work payload with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 12))
              | none => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .pos) none (some (ctrl 13))
            else
              match work payload with
              | some b => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .pos) (some b) (some (ctrl 13))
              | none => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, 0) none none }
-- @shim end

-- @shim begin (verbatim from `Build/Loop.lean`: the current shared controller)
private def loopBodyTM (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) : FinTM Bool where
  k := body.k + 1
  State := body.State × Bool
  tm :=
    { q₀ := (body.tm.q₀, false)
      tr := fun q inp work =>
        if q.1 = anchor ∧ q.2 = false then
          { inputTape := 0
            workTapes := fun i =>
              if (i : ℕ) < body.k then (none, 0) else (some (some false), 0)
            output := none
            state := none }
        else
          let a := body.tm.tr q.1 inp (fun i => work i.castSucc)
          { inputTape := a.inputTape
            workTapes := fun i =>
              if h : (i : ℕ) < body.k then a.workTapes ⟨i, h⟩
              else (if a.state = none then some (some true) else none, 0)
            output := a.output
            state := a.state.map (fun s => (s, false)) } }

private abbrev LoopHostState (body F : FinTM Bool) :=
  F.State ⊕ ((Bool × (body.State × Bool)) ⊕ Fin 14)

private def loopFuelSource (body F : FinTM Bool) :
    MultiTapeTM (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) Bool F.State where
  q₀ := F.tm.q₀
  tr := fun q inp work =>
    rightAction (body.k + 1) id (rightAction 1 id
      (F.tm.tr q inp fun i => work (Fin.natAdd (body.k + 1) (Fin.natAdd 1 i))))

private def loopBodySource (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) :
    MultiTapeTM (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) Bool (body.State × Bool) where
  q₀ := (body.tm.q₀, false)
  tr := fun q inp work => leftAction (1 + F.k) id
    ((loopBodyTM body anchor).tm.tr q inp fun i => work (Fin.castAdd (1 + F.k) i))

private def loopControlAction (body F : FinTM Bool) (inp : SignType)
    (flag : Option (Option Bool)) (counter payload : Option (Option Bool) × SignType)
    (out : Option Bool) (next : Option (LoopHostState body F)) :
    Action (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) where
  inputTape := inp
  workTapes := fun i =>
    if (i : ℕ) = body.k then (flag, 0)
    else if (i : ℕ) = body.k + 1 then counter
    else if (i : ℕ) = body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) then payload
    else (none, 0)
  output := out
  state := next

private def loopBodyDispatch (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward : Bool)
    (startup : Bool) (s : body.State × Bool) (inp : Option Bool)
    (work : Fin (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) → Option Bool) :
    Action (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) :=
  bif forward then
    leftAction 1 id (Turing.emitAction (fun s => .inr (.inl (startup, s)))
      (.inr (.inr (if startup then 6 else 7)))
      ((loopBodySource body F anchor).tr s inp (fun i => work i.castSucc)))
  else
    captureAction (fun s => .inr (.inl (startup, s)))
      (.inr (.inr (if startup then 6 else 7)))
      ((loopBodySource body F anchor).tr s inp fun i => work i.castSucc)

private def loopHostM (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward findMode : Bool) :
    FinTM Bool where
  k := body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1
  State := LoopHostState body F
  tm :=
    { q₀ := .inl F.tm.q₀
      tr := fun q inp work =>
        let ctrl (j : Fin 14) : LoopHostState body F := .inr (.inr j)
        let call (startup : Bool) (s : body.State × Bool) : LoopHostState body F :=
          .inr (.inl (startup, s))
        let flag : Fin (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) := ⟨body.k, by omega⟩
        let counter : Fin (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) := ⟨body.k + 1, by omega⟩
        let payload := Fin.last (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k))
        let act := loopControlAction body F
        match q with
        | .inl s => captureAction Sum.inl (ctrl 0)
            ((loopFuelSource body F).tr s inp fun i => work i.castSucc)
        | .inr (.inl (startup, s)) => loopBodyDispatch body F anchor forward startup s inp work
        | .inr (.inr phase) =>
            if phase = 0 then act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 1))
            else if phase = 1 then
              match work payload with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 1))
              | none => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .pos) none (some (ctrl 2))
            else if phase = 2 then
              match work payload with
              | some b => act 0 none (some (some b), .pos) (some none, .pos) none
                  (some (ctrl 2))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 3))
            else if phase = 3 then
              match work counter with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 3))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .pos) (none, .pos) none (some (ctrl 4))
            else if phase = 4 then act .neg none (none, 0) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 5))
            else if phase = 5 then
              match inp with
              | some _ => act .neg none (none, 0) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 5))
              | none => act .pos none (none, 0) (none, 0) none
                  (some (call true (body.tm.q₀, false)))
            else if phase = 6 then act 0 (some none) (none, 0) (none, 0) none
              (some (call false (anchor, true)))
            else if phase = 7 then
              if work flag = some true then
                if findMode then act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 12))
                else act 0 none (none, 0) (none, 0) (some true) none
              else act 0 (some none) (none, 0) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 8))
            else if phase = 8 then
              match work counter with
              | some false => act 0 none (some (some true), .pos) (none, 0) none
                  (some (ctrl 8))
              | some true => act 0 none (some (some false), .neg) (none, 0) none
                  (some (ctrl 9))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 10))
            else if phase = 9 then
              match work counter with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 9))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .pos) (none, 0) none
                  (some (call false (anchor, true)))
            else if phase = 10 then
              match work counter with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 10))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .pos) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 11))
            else if phase = 11 then
              act 0 none (none, 0) (none, 0) (if findMode then none else some false) none
            else if phase = 12 then
              match work payload with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 12))
              | none => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .pos) none (some (ctrl 13))
            else
              match work payload with
              | some b => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .pos) (some b) (some (ctrl 13))
              | none => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, 0) none none }
-- @shim end

/-- The old host is the shared controller with the forwarding flag off, definitionally. -/
example (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (findMode : Bool) :
    f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode = loopHostM body F anchor false findMode := rfl

/-- `f2_sum_add` (`Build/Catalog.lean:10468`) is `Fin.sum_univ_add`. -/
example {a b : ℕ} (f : Fin (a + b) → ℕ) :
    (∑ i : Fin (a + b), f i) =
      (∑ i : Fin a, f (Fin.castAdd b i)) + ∑ i : Fin b, f (Fin.natAdd a i) :=
  Fin.sum_univ_add f

/-- `f2_loop_input_run_le` (`Build/Catalog.lean:6126`) is `MultiTapeTM.timed_input_bound`. -/
example {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ) :
    (tm.runFrom c t).inputPos.val ≤ c.inputPos.val + t :=
  tm.timed_input_bound c t

/-- `f2_catalogPair_inverse` (`Build/Catalog.lean:4166`) is `Turing.eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode`
with its binders reordered. -/
example (x : List Bool) :
    ∀ a v, pairDecode x = some (a, v) → x = pairEncode a v :=
  fun a v h => Turing.eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode x a v h

## ===== audits/evidence/mig0b/r2/NOTES-r2.md =====

# MIG-0b round 2: notes (2026-10-13)

Drafted read-only by a maintainer sub-agent against the checkout `wt-r2m0b`. It was at campaign
commit `385d6e5a` when the work started, and at `1781a230` (PR #84, fills-8) for every result
reported here. Elaboration used `oleans-f8` (all of TCSlib at `1781a230`), only through
`tools/leanelab.sh`. No `lake`, no git, no build command, no network; no `.olean` written. Figures
are labelled **MEASURED** (from a file or a run) or **ESTIMATE**. Paths are repository paths unless
they start with `<OUT>`, the round-2 output directory. D and A are round 1's draft and adapters
files (`audits/evidence/mig0b/Contract-mig0b-{draft,adapters}.lean.txt`).

**fills-8, merged mid-task.** Between the two commits only `CodeSimulator.lean` and
`Build/RecordTable.lean` changed (MEASURED: SHA-256 of `Build/Contract.lean`, `Build/Seam.lean`,
`Build/CounterLoop.lean`, `Build/Embed.lean`, `Build/Catalog.lean`, `Finite.lean` and
`StateRenaming.lean` unchanged). Every check below was re-run at `1781a230`. fills-8 matters in
three places (§7): a new unfolding consumer of `counterLoopOrbit` (`CodeSimulator.lean:5841`), a
new private copy of the R1 reconstruction lemma (`RecordTable.rt_embed_matches`, over `Type*`), and
shifted line numbers.

## 1. What changed since round 1

| Round-1 item | Round 2 |
|---|---|
| D started with a **copy** of the gated MIG-0a file; the split was a plan (NOTES §6) with a probe that kept the fit bridge and left out the seam consumers | The split is **the draft**: one landing unit of 13 parts (`<OUT>/Contract-mig0b-r2-unit.lean`), generated from the **landed** `Build/Contract.lean` and the round-1 evidence by `build.py`, each part cut-checked in exactly its own import closure, with no fit namespace in the unit and the seam consumers in their own module (finding 1) |
| `mem_hull_left/right`, `runFrom_state_none_mono` private in the core, used by the seam proofs | **Deleted.** Their 12 uses cite public results: Mathlib's `Finset.Icc_subset_Icc` (7 hull uses) and `Finite`'s `MultiTapeTM.runFrom_state_ne_none_of_le` (5 halting uses: `seq_traj`, `live`, `branch_traj`, `Segment.live`, `ReturnContract.toRound`) |
| `counterLoopTMVia_done_witness` called `MIG0bFit.counterLoop_hround_of_rounds` | Derives the round hypothesis locally from `Round.cut_some`, as the escape witness already did; the fit lemma stays in the fit file |
| `seamReleaseTM_runFrom_pos` over `Type`, via `runFrom_mapState_of_agreeOn` | **Dropped.** `Build/Seam`'s private `seamRelease_run_pos` is promoted under that name with its universes and its step-commutation proof, together with its two step lemmas (`seamReleaseTM_step_fresh`, `seamReleaseTM_step_inr`) (finding 2) |
| Layering homes: `Deterministic` for the two raw-layer lemmas | **`Finite`**: `Finite.lean` is where raw-layer additions go, "so the vendored `Deterministic.lean` stays byte-comparable with upstream" (its own docstring; `Deterministic` is vendored from cslib) |
| `counterLoopOrbit` unchanged, with an `rfl` lemma | An `abbrev` of `roundOrbit` (Q11); the four proofs that unfold it are edited and checked, three of them outside the MIG-0b files (§6) |
| `ReturnContract.release`'s envelope through the visited sets | Through the pointwise lockstep (Q14), statement unchanged |
| Minors 3–5 | `Contract.lockstep_admissible` and `_map` with the condition documented; `RoundContract.release`'s two-exit claim qualified; a literal proof sketch for the admitted lockstep and the full [AB09] entry where it is cited |

Also new in round 2, each explained in §5: the raw-layer exports that move into `Build/Embed` and
`Build/Seam` take those modules' universes (`Type*`); `embedEmitCfg_select` is re-derived from the
R1 lemma; `workTapePos_runFrom_mem_Icc` is stated over any alphabet and state type.

## 2. The unit, and why it is built from the landed file rather than importing it

The brief asked for the round-2 draft as an increment on the landed `Build/Contract.lean`,
importing it. A pure increment cannot be the landing form, for two reasons the split exists to
remove:
1. `Build/Loop` (MIG-17) and other lower modules must import the core, but the landed file imports
   `Build/Catalog`, which imports `Build/Loop`.
2. MIG-0b's seam layer (`Traj.seq`, `Traj.inPhase`, `Traj.branch`, `Frames.seq`,
   `RoundContract.release`) uses the landed file's **private** trajectory lemmas (`seq_traj`,
   `inPhase_traj`, `branch_traj`, `release_start`, `mapState_state`), which another module cannot
   see; finding 1 is this problem's other half.

So the MIG-0a text must move, and the evidence is made to match what lands in a different way:
`build.py` takes every MIG-0a declaration **by name from the landed file** (not from D's copy),
asserts that each of the 37 landed declarations is taken exactly once or is in a declared
retirement list, applies every edit as an exact replacement asserted to match once, and records
each block's source and hashes in `<OUT>/manifest.json`. `identity.py` then re-derives, from the
files themselves, that the landed file is the gated round-2 file with only its status paragraph
changed, and lists each declaration's fate (§8). The round-1 MIG-0b declarations are taken by name
from D and A in the same way (91 of 93 kept, 2 retired; MEASURED).

**Part kinds.** A part is *appended* to an existing module when it lists that module among its
imports (Finite ×2, StateRenaming, Build/Embed, Robustness/AlphabetReduction), the **whole edited
file** of an existing module when it does not (Build/Seam, Build/CounterLoop, and Build/Contract,
which becomes the facade), and otherwise a new module (Contract/Basic, /Seam, /Embed, /Catalog,
/Lift). A `-- @moved-from M` part holds declarations moved verbatim from `M`.

**The cut check** (`cutcheck2.py`) extends `audits/evidence/stage2-gate/scripts/cutcheck.py`:
- the closure follows existing modules too, so an appended part reaches every check whose
  closure holds its module (the CounterLoop check includes the Embed part through
  `Catalog → Loop → Embed`, and the AlphabetReduction part through `Catalog → Encoding →
  SingleTape → AlphabetReduction`);
- a moved part is omitted where its old home is already imported (its body is byte-identical to
  the old copy, `identity.py` §3.3, and its printed type too, `sigprobe.py`);
- a check stops if an existing module of its closure imports a module that an included part
  replaces;
- extras parts (`<OUT>/extras.lean`, generated by `mkextras.py`) check the edited existing files
  whole, in their own closures, the downstream consumers of Q11, and the fit file over every
  landing module.

The method checks each landing module against the *old* oleans of the modules below it plus the
parts in its closure. It does not rebuild the 170 modules that would newly have the core in their
closure, or the 26 that depend on `Build/CounterLoop` (MEASURED, `graphcheck.py` and
`tools/closure.py`): the landing PR's replay remains a separate obligation, as the auditor said.

## 3. The revised layering plan

All line counts MEASURED on `<OUT>/landing/`, the files the landing PR writes (header included).

| Module | Kind | Imports (as landed) | Lines | Contents |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Finite` | appended (parts 1, 2) | unchanged | 354 → 410 | `MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_le_card_Icc` (moved from `Build/Catalog:392`, verbatim); `MultiTapeTM.workTapePos_runFrom_mem_Icc` (round 1's export over `Type*`); docstring entries |
| `StateRenaming` | appended (part 3) | + `Simulation` | 124 → 182 | `MultiTapeTM.runFrom_mapState_of_agreeOn` (moved from `Build/Embed:1010`, verbatim; its signature, `{S H : Type}`, kept); docstring entry |
| `Build/Embed` | appended (part 4) | + `Build/Convention` | 1,049 → 1,126 | the moved block deleted; `embedEmitCfg_unselected`, `Cfg.select`, `embedEmitCfg_select` (moved from `Build/Contract`), `embedEmitCfg_eq`, `_mapState_eq`, `_ofWords_eq`; all over `Type*` |
| `Build/Seam` | whole file (part 5) | unchanged | 854 → 873 | `seamComp_right` promoted as `seamCompTM_runFrom_right`; `seamRelease_fresh_step`, `_step_right`, `_run_pos` promoted as `seamReleaseTM_step_fresh`, `_step_inr`, `_runFrom_pos`; 6 call sites renamed; docstring |
| `Build/Contract/Basic` | new (part 6) | `Linarith`, `Simulation`, `StateRenaming` | 1,309 | MIG-0a: `Contract`, `within`, `spaceUsedByTape_le`, `Positive`, `mem_Icc_of_abs_le`, `trans`, `live`, the frame layer, `ReturnContract`. MIG-0b: segments, `SafeSegment`, the bridges, rounds, `roundOrbit`, `RoundContract` with `returning`/`escaping`, `ReturnContract.toRound`, the orbit hulls, `headBox_lastCases`, `Traj` with `trans`, `Frames.trans`, the sanity lemmas, `Contract.mapState`, `Lockstep`, `Contract.lockstep`, `lockstep_admissible(_map)` |
| `Robustness/AlphabetReduction` | appended (part 7) | + `Build/Contract/Basic` | 884 → 969 | the admitted lockstep and the contract theorem (open question 1) |
| `Build/Contract/Seam` | new (part 8) | `Contract/Basic`, `Build/Seam` | 815 | MIG-0a: `seq`, `inPhase`, `Cfg.bindState`, `branch`, `ReturnContract.release` with their private trajectory lemmas. MIG-0b: `RoundContract.release`, `Traj.seq/inPhase/branch`, `Frames.seq`, positivity |
| `Build/Contract/Embed` | new (part 9) | `Contract/Basic`, `Build/Embed` | 128 | `embed`, `Traj.embed`, `embed_positive` |
| `Build/Contract/Catalog` | new (part 10) | `Contract/Basic`, `Build/Catalog` | 102 | `clearTM_contract`, `_frames`, `_traj` (MIG-11's instances join it) |
| `Build/Contract/Lift` | new (part 11) | `Contract/Basic`, `SymbolLift` | 82 | `Contract.liftSymbols` |
| `Build/CounterLoop` | whole file (part 12) | + `Build/Contract/Basic` | 1,699 → 2,118 | `counterLoopOrbit` an abbreviation of `roundOrbit`; one proof edit; the `_witness`/`_segment` theorems, `counterLoopBody`, `counterLoopCfg_body`, `counterValue`, `RoundContract.counterLoopDone/Escape` with `_traj`; docstring |
| `Build/Contract` | whole file: the facade (part 13) | the five `Contract/*` modules | 1,101 → 52 | `## Contents` |
| `Build/Catalog` | edit only | unchanged | 12,752 → 12,732 | the moved lemma deleted; docstring |
| `Build/CfgRecord`, `CodeSimulator` | edit only | unchanged | unchanged | Q11's consumers (§6) |
| `Build/Zone`, `TuringMachine` (facade) | docstrings | unchanged | unchanged | the lemma's home; the `Build/Contract` entry |

The core's closure is `Configuration`, `Deterministic`, `Finite`, `Simulation`, `StateRenaming`
(MEASURED, `graphcheck.py`), so `Build/Loop`, `Build/CounterLoop`, `Build/Catalog`, `Build/Embed`,
`Build/Seam` and `Robustness/SingleTape` can all import it; the import graph with the landing files
substituted is acyclic. Imports were checked by elaboration, not reasoned: each part's check imports
exactly the closure above. `TCSlib.lean` needs no change: it imports `TuringMachine`, which imports
the facade.

**Basic's size.** It is 1,309 lines, and the repository lint calls a file over 1,000 lines a split
candidate (auditor note 19). File size alone is not a reason to split (user rule); the module is
one import boundary (everything `Build/Loop` and `Build/CounterLoop` may need), and a further split
would add modules without moving any boundary. No split is proposed.

## 4. The findings

**Finding 1.** Resolved as above. The cut checks run with `MIG0bFit` absent from the unit
(`build.py` asserts it). The seam consumers that broke are in `Build/Contract/Seam`, checked over
`Contract/Basic` and `Build/Seam` alone: `seq_traj`, `seq`, `branch_traj` and `branch` now use only
public results, and `live` is public in the core. `counterLoopTMVia_done_witness` no longer refers
to the fit namespace. The other private helpers left (`mapState_state`, `mapState_const_inl(_inl)`,
the three trajectory lemmas, `release_start`, `mapState_traj`) are each used only inside their own
module, which the checks confirm.

**Finding 2.** The promoted lemma keeps the private lemma's statement (`{Symbol : Type*}`, the
section's `{S : Type*}`) and its proof through `seamReleaseTM_step_fresh`, `seamReleaseTM_step_inr`
and `MultiTapeTM.runFrom_comm_of_step`; it does not use `runFrom_mapState_of_agreeOn`. The public
consumers `seamReleaseTM_firstReturn` and `seamReleaseTM_visitedByTapeHead` keep their statements
byte for byte (`identity.py` §3.5) and their printed types (all 18 public `Build/Seam` declarations,
`sigprobe.py`); only their call sites changed. The fit file checks that round 1's `Type` statement
is an instance, and instantiates the lemma at a machine whose state carrier is `Type` itself, the
auditor's example.

**Minor 3.** `Contract.lockstep_admissible`: if `enc` maps every source configuration at `entry` to
one at `entry'`, every admissible source start `c` gives the admissible target start `enc c`;
`_map` is the case of a state-renaming encoding with `entry' = ρ entry`. `Contract.lockstep`'s
docstring states the condition. The fit file has the auditor's case (identity encoding, `b ≠ a`:
no admissible start) and the compatible case.

**Minor 4.** `RoundContract.release`'s docstring now says that the escape set is arbitrary (it may
hold `none`, several states, or the anchor), that only `escape = {some e}` with `e ≠ anchor` gives
two distinct live exits, the shape of `branch`'s first phase, and that the phase host needs in
general that `none` is not an exit and the redirect conditions. Two fit examples check the halting
case and the singleton case. The formal statement is unchanged. The round-1 notes' row for it
(§3) is superseded by this one.

**Minor 5.** `exists_alphabetReduction_lockstep` has a literal `**Proof sketch.**` naming the
witnesses (`arTM` with the one-hot code, `L = 3(|Γ| + 1) + 2`, `ρ = arReady`, `enc = arCfg`) and
covering the step equation (`arCfg_cycle`) with a halted source, offset `0` (injectivity of `ρ`),
the intermediate controls (live read, write and move controls, none of the form `arReady q`, so
outside the renamed `X` for every `X`, `none ∈ X` included), and the halted source's offsets. The
full [AB09] entry is in the new section's docstring and in `AlphabetReduction`'s References (which
already had it), and in `Contract/Basic`'s References, where `Lockstep` cites Claim 1.5.

**Minor 6.** The record corrections are listed in §10, not made.

**Rulings applied.** Q11 (§6). Q14: `ReturnContract.release`'s envelope at time `0` is the start's,
and at positive times the release run is the right-tagged source run (`seamReleaseTM_runFrom_pos`);
its statement and data fields are unchanged and the sketch was rewritten to match.

## 5. Changes beyond the findings, and why

1. **Raw-layer exports take their host module's universes.** Finding 2's principle is that the
   contract structures' `Type` convention does not justify narrowing a raw-layer lemma. Applied to
   the other moves:
   - `seamCompTM_runFrom_right`. MIG-0a's export (over `Type`) had a private polymorphic twin in
     `Build/Seam` (`seamComp_right`). The twin is promoted under the export's name; the landed
     statement is an instance (checked).
   - `embedEmitCfg_unselected`, `Cfg.select` and `embedEmitCfg_select` (MIG-0a), and
     `embedEmitCfg_eq`, `_mapState_eq` and `_ofWords_eq` (round 1). They are stated over

@@ -69,6 +69,11 @@
 * `Turing.MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt` — a run halted by time `t` halts first at some
   `u ≤ t`, live before `u` and already in its time-`t` configuration (the first-halt
   argument, public for the oracle query capture; added 2026-10-11, B1).
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_le_card_Icc` — a head confined to an integer interval
+  visits at most its cardinality (moved from `Build/Catalog` at MIG-0b's layering split, for
+  the contract core, 2026-10-13).
+* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.workTapePos_runFrom_mem_Icc` — after `u` steps every work head lies
+  within `u` cells of its start (MIG-0b, 2026-10-13).
 
 ## References
 
@@ -352,3 +357,54 @@
 end FinTM
 
 end Turing
+
+namespace Turing
+
+/-- A head confined to an integer interval visits at most its cardinality.
+
+(Moved from `Build/Zone.lean` for B4, 2026-10-12.)
+
+**Proof sketch.** The visited set is a finite image contained in the
+interval by hypothesis; `Finset.card_le_card` and `Int.card_Icc` finish. -/
+theorem MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_le_card_Icc {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*}
+    {input : List Symbol} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State)
+    (d : Cfg k Symbol State input) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (lo hi : ℤ)
+    (h : ∀ u ≤ t, (tm.runFrom d u).workTapePos i ∈ Finset.Icc lo hi) :
+    tm.spaceUsedByTape d t i ≤ (hi + 1 - lo).toNat := by
+  unfold MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape
+  calc
+    _ ≤ (Finset.Icc lo hi).card := Finset.card_le_card (by
+      intro p hp
+      obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
+      exact h u (by simpa only [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hu))
+    _ = _ := Int.card_Icc lo hi
+
+end Turing
+
+namespace Turing
+
+/-- **The time-derived head envelope** (MIG-0b): after `u` steps from `cfg`, every work head
+lies within `u` cells of its start. Every row with a time bound therefore has an interval
+envelope, even when it states none (the install and emit calls; the find round). It is the
+interval form of `Build/Catalog`'s private `f2_head_steps`, which retires with MIG-1 (backlog
+F6-1(g)), and of the run head bound that the H2 promotion exports
+(`CodeSimulator.h1Run_headBound`, backlog F7-1(a)); stated here over any alphabet and state
+type, like the raw layer it extends.
+
+**Proof sketch.** Induction on `u`: each step moves a head by at most one cell
+(`Turing.MultiTapeTM.workTapePos_step_le`). -/
+theorem MultiTapeTM.workTapePos_runFrom_mem_Icc {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*}
+    {input : List Symbol} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input)
+    (u : ℕ) (j : Fin k) :
+    (tm.runFrom cfg u).workTapePos j ∈
+      Finset.Icc (cfg.workTapePos j - u) (cfg.workTapePos j + u) := by
+  induction u with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ u ih =>
+    have hs := abs_le.mp (tm.workTapePos_step_le (tm.runFrom cfg u) j)
+    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at ih ⊢
+    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
+    push_cast
+    constructor <;> omega
+
+end Turing

/-
